articleTitle: Bridging Tradition and Technology: Enabling Thai Temple Bell Beater Control through IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study delves into the convergence of tradition and technology through the utilization of the Internet of Things (IoT) to modernize Thai temple bell practices. Temples, essential for worship and Buddhist rituals, trace their origins to the time of the Buddha and play a pivotal role in Thai culture. Buddhism’s introduction to Thailand occurred around 236 B.C., leading to the establishment of numerous temples. These temples, categorized as Royal Monasteries and Wat Rat, house both sacred structures and monks’ quarters. Despite the transformation of daily routines due to urbanization and technology, temple bells continue to signify auspicious beginnings. The study proposes integrating IoT technology to remotely control temple bells while preserving their cultural importance. The research’s primary objectives include designing and developing a system to remotely activate temple bells for novice monks, assessing rhythm and sound precision, and exploring temple bell control through IoT technology. The proposed system employs an ESP8266 microcontroller to manage bell functions, pneumatic cylinders for control, and relay mechanisms for striking and pulling the bell. The study successfully achieves its goals by demonstrating the accurate and consistent functioning of remote bell control, harmonizing tradition and modernity, and offering recommendations for implementing this technology in temple management.

articleTitle: Design and Build a Web-Based e-Learning System using ReactJS Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Online learning (e-learning) is a method of streamlining the teaching and learning activities of teachers and students without having to meet face to face. One of the schools that requested online learning is Madinatul Ilmi Foundation, which has limited facilities in classrooms. The Madinatul Ilmi Foundation welcomes many students from primary to vocational, but the lack of space forces some students to carry out learning activities at home. This also makes some students feel like they don’t understand the instructional material being explained. The purpose of this research is to construct a web-based e-learning data framework that can be utilized as a supplement or substitute for learning exercises. This framework will also provide easy and quick access for students and teachers to share learning material. It is also hoped that this could increase the productivity of students who want to study outside of class. The framework advancement strategy utilized is Fast Application Improvement (RAD). The framework design using Unified Modeling Language (UML). Use the Javascript programming language, using the ReactJS framework and PostgreSQL database, then further test the system using black box testing. This study creates an online learning system that students and teachers can directly access, where teachers can manage existing materials and can also manage tests/quizzes multiple-choice. Students can also access eLearning to view available materials and tests/quizzes.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Key Management Service Performance on AWS, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud with Performance Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Although switching to cloud technology for free exclusive can give cost advantage and efficiency, it requires policies, processes, and practices best security level business calculated. Based on survey to industry experts, available problem security in cloud computing, including data breaches identified as a problem security top need _attention more. Most entry way sense to prevent data breach involves practice security in data storage, for example data encryption. But if happen lost key encryption, then it will also data loss. It supported by abundance data breaches that have occurred in the last 5 years recently, especially in Indonesia. To overcome security and management issues key encryption, some cloud providers provide Key Management Services (KMS) services. This research will compare the performance of Key Management Services from cloud providers AWS, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud with load testing methods, stress testing, and benchmark testing. The parameters assessed from this research are response time, error rate, throughput, and latency. The resulting research results are recommendations for the best cloud providers in Key Management Services. The result shows AWS can say better compared Google Cloud and Oracle because constant error rate lower from Google Cloud and Oracle, competitive response time and latency. Throughput (requests per second) obtained almost always more excels at every testing.

articleTitle: Mood of Song Detection Using Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient and Convolutional Neural Network with Tuning Hyperparameter
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Music is divided into various types, one of which is divided according to the character of the music itself. Human have a tendency to listen to music based on mood because music have a close bond with the condition of human heart. This study tries to identify the types of musical moods for music classification using the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) Algorithm. This method is one of the methods that has been widely used in the field of Speech Technology, where this method aims to perform feature extraction and sound classification. The RMSprop optimizer with Uniform kernel as a hyperparameter tuning model produced the study’s most ideal outcomes, according to test findings utilizing the K-Fold cross validation technique. As a consequence, average values for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-Score were 79.55%, 85%, 79%, and 81% respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Gimbal Stabilization Using DMP and Kalman Filter: A Low-Cost Approach with MPU6050 Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research explores the application of a 3Degree of Freedom (DOF) gimbal system that utilizes input from the MPU6050 sensor for gimbal stabilization. Maintaining precision and stability in gimbals is of utmost importance, making them a compelling subject in automation controlled by modern controllers. This study involves the implementation of both the Digital Motion Processor (DMP) and Kalman Filter to control gimbal stability, and their performance is compared through simulations. The results demonstrate the superiority of the DMP algorithm, achieving an accuracy rate of 99.3% with an average error of 0.7096, outperforming the Kalman filter, which achieved an accuracy rate of 67.65% with an error of 33.35. The mechanical design of the stabilizer involved manual construction using cardboard and subsequent 3D printing, resulting in a functional system capable of smooth movement. In summary, this study confirms the effectiveness of the DMP algorithm in enhancing sensor data stability and accuracy, thus laying the foundation for low-cost, precise gimbal stabilizer systems.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Open Shortest Path First Multiarea Using Virtual Link Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The quality of a network service is the most important factor to determine reliability in the process of transferring data packets. The selection of routing protocols is a determining factor in large networks. The implementation of Virtual Link in the Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) Multiarea Routing Protocol can be a solution and alternative to implementing Single Area OSPF and Multiarea OSPF. OSPF Multiarea using virtual links can connect areas that are separated by the backbone area created by implementing OSPF Multiarea. Virtual links use link-states to link separate areas. The results of the research on OSPF Multiarea Virtual link in OSPF area 1 with router-id 1.1.1.1 located on Router-A have a link-state to OSPF area 2 with router-id 3.3.3.3 located on Router-C. And OSPF Multiarea can summarize the routing table in a router device, this aims to minimize too many routing tables if using OSPF Single area in such a large network service.

articleTitle: Comparing GraphQL and ReST Architecture in Arabic Learning Games: A Quality of Service (QoS) Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The development of Arabic learning applications has advanced with the incorporation of gamification, combining game elements with language learning skills like listening, speaking, reading, and writing. However, the use of the ReST (Representational State Transfer) architecture has presented challenges, leading to slow data response times and hindering access to learning features. To address this issue, the adoption of the GraphQL (Graph Query Language) architecture is proposed as a solution to overcome the limitations of ReST. GraphQL's popularity among developers makes it a suitable alternative for handling data distribution challenges from the server to the database. This study aims to implement the GraphQL architecture in Arabic learning game applications, which has proven to be successful and feasible. The quality of service testing confirms that the GraphQL implementation exhibits faster response times, more efficient utilization of processing resources, and lower memory usage compared to the ReST architecture.

articleTitle: Improving Digital Literacy of Rural Women Entrepreneurs in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Digital technology plays a pivotal role in business development of women entrepreneurs today. It enables women entrepreneurs to have more active participation in economic sector. Nevertheless, less women have digital literacy and skill that making them difficult to expand business market. This research aims to portray women economic empowerment activities to improve rural women entrepreneurs’ literacy and skill in digital usage. This research employs observation, in-depth interview and survey to 78 rural women entrepreneurs from 3 provinces in Indonesia. These women are participants of economic empowerment program conducted by Social Trust Fund of UIN Jakarta. The finding revealed that proper strategy, program compatibility and taking situation of rural women as consideration will make empowerment program becoming more optimal to improve women digital literacy.

articleTitle: WebQual 4.0 Plus: An Approach to Measure Customer Satisfaction toward Website Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: A division of the Mizan Group called Mizanstore.com specializes in online or e-book stores. Mizanstore.com places a high priority on client pleasure. Implementing strong online service quality to facilitate transactions is one of the things that can raise customer satisfaction. However, according to the findings of interviews and observations, many customers are dissatisfied with the level of website services provided by Mizanstore.com. The purpose of this study is to determine the factors that can influence customer satisfaction on Mizanstore.com’s website. Usability, information quality, service interaction quality, system availability, and user satisfaction are the five variables that make up the 32 questions that make up this research, which is quantitative because it uses the WebQual 4.0 approach in conjunction with system availability in E-S-Qual. Purposive sampling was used to distribute the questionnaire online, and 415 people responded. Multiple linear regression analyses are used in data analysis to find the variables that significantly affect customer satisfaction. According to the findings, consumer satisfaction is neutral, with an average rating of 3.59. Customer satisfaction is partially and simultaneously affected by the usability variable (33%), information quality (13%), service interaction quality (30%), and system availability (24%%), which affect customer satisfaction partially and simultaneously (70.7%).

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Citizen on Twitter in Accessibility of Disabilities at The Public Space Using Support Vector Machine (SVM) Method with Radial Basis Function (RBF) Kernel
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: According to the Ministry of Social Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia, based on data from the Biro Pusat Statistik (BPS), there were $\mathbf{2 2 . 5}$ million people with disabilities in Indonesia until October 2020. As time goes on, people with disabilities may increase. So facilities and infrastructure that are friendly to people with disabilities must be given great attention. Various comments from the public regarding this matter arose on social media, especially Twitter, both from positive to negative comments. There are 1209 tweets in Indonesian related to this matter which will be classified using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm with the Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel using GridSearch and Cross Validation. The parameters used are in the range $\mathrm{C}=[0.01$; $0.1; 1; 10; 100; 1,000; 10,000; 100,000; 1,000,000; 10,000,000]$ and $\gamma=[0.0000001; 0.000001; 0.00001; 0.0001; 0.001; 0.01; 0.1;$ $1; 10; 100]$ and produces a maximum accuracy of the parameter combination $C=1.000$ and $\gamma=0.000001(\mathrm{le}-06)$ of $83.37 \%$ which supports previous research that a good and appropriate parameter combination of C and $\gamma$ in the RBF kernel SVM method will produce maximum accuracy of the classification results.

articleTitle: REMAS: Real-Time Emergency and Monitoring Alert System for Neonatal Incubator using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study proposes a Real-Time Emergency and Monitoring Alert System for Baby Incubators using the Internet of Things (IoT). This system aims to improve the safety of premature babies treated in incubators by continuously monitoring the environmental conditions of the incubators using sensors connected to the internet. Data from these sensors are sent directly to the server via the internet network to be processed for analysis and stored in a database. This system is also equipped with an automatic notification feature in an emergency, such as a dangerous increase in temperature. This notification will be received by parents or medical staff via the Line application so that they can immediately provide the treatment they need. In addition, parents and medical staff can see the condition of the incubator in real-time via a web page. The system test results show that the web application can work properly, and the IoT device can accurately monitor the environmental conditions of the incubator and baby’s environmental conditions and provide real-time notifications when an emergency occurs with a delivery delay of 0-3 seconds. As for the results of sending data to the database for 80 minutes with a delay of 1 second, 4010 of 4800 data were obtained, which means the percentage of missing value is 16.45%, and the range of sensor values is between 32.2°C to 35.3°C.

articleTitle: The Role Of Social Media in Knowledge Management: A Comprehensive Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: With the rise of social media, knowledge management (KM) practices have experienced considerable changes. In the modern digital world, social media has evolved into a potent and omnipresent technology that is revolutionizing many facets of communication and information exchange. This comprehensive evaluation of the literature intends to investigate and evaluate the function of social media in knowledge management. This review examines the relationship between using social media for efficient knowledge management practices by synthesizing previous research papers. The results show that social media platforms have several benefits for producing knowledge. They provide people with a digital forum in which to discuss and converse about their thoughts, perceptions, and experiences. Social media makes it possible for information to spread quickly, reaching a large audience and enabling direct reactions and involvement. It encourages chance discoveries and allows for the investigation of many viewpoints, promoting the production of original ideas that might affect the decision-making process.

articleTitle: Analysis of Strengths and Weaknesses of Software Testing Strategies: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Software Testing is a crucial phase in a software development cycle. To deepen the understanding of software testing strategies, this study aims to identify and provide an analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of testing strategies. The approach used in this research is Systematic Literature Review (SLR). Various sources discussing software testing strategies have been summarized and reviewed according to the SLR process. The result of this study is the discovery of four descriptions of software testing strategies, in which each classification is decomposed into several types and then the advantages and disadvantages are explained.

articleTitle: Enhancing Small Dataset Performance: Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning in Indonesian Traditional Foods Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: One of the difficulties in deep learning is making a model with small dataset. Overfitting, outliers, low accuracy, noise, and general poor performance often caused by lack of information given to the model in learning process. Transfer learning is a method where solving a problem will be carried out using a model that has previously been trained by other. With transfer learning, models that have been trained can be used to continue training on smaller or specific datasets. Besides transfer learning, data augmentation can also be used as alternative solution. By images modification, augmenation process will give additional images to the model. In this research, several methods will be carried out, which are augmentation and transfer learning to produce a model that is able to recognize images of Indonesian traditional food. Based on the test results, it was found that the use of data augmentation can reduce the accuracy gap between training and validation data. With 89% of accuracy and decrease in loss values for all data (training, validation, and testing data), it proved that the utilization of data augmentation and transfer learning enhanced overall model performance.

articleTitle: Improvement Control of a Three Axis Articulated Robotic Arm Using PID Cascade Control
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, the demand for flexibility in automation is getting higher and higher. The industrial robotic arm is considered the most flexible tool in the automation process. Vocational schools should prepare their students to be ready to work with industrial robots. However, the price of an industrial robot is still very expensive. This problem becomes a barrier in preparing the manpower in the robotic field. This research investigated the potential of making an industrial robot trainer module using a 3D printer. Besides supporting the flexibility of the robotic design, the robot became much cheaper compared to the commercial one. The 3D-printed robotic arm may have less accuracy, repeatability, and reliability than branded robots, but it can be used to teach the student of basic operation of a robotic arm. An Arduino board is implemented to control the arm. Cascade PID Controller was implemented on the Arduino to control the robot joins. The result shows satisfactory robot performance. The cascade PID Controller can control the robot joints in a good way.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Internet of Things Enabled CNC Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The phenomenon of globalisation, coupled with the increasing consumer demand for goods, is compelling manufacturing companies to enhance their operational efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and environmental sustainability. The advent of Industry 4.0 has presented significant opportunities for the manufacturing industry to use smart manufacturing technologies, hence enabling the transformation of traditional systems into Internet of Things (IoT) enabled systems. This paper outlines the process of creating a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) system that incorporates Internet of Things (IoT) technology for didactic purpose. The system designed and built to incorporate a CNC lathe, sensors for monitoring of performance, an IoT gateway, edge devices, a human-machine interface (HMI), and an IoT platform known as anto.io. The first step is CNC mechanism design and development. This step is already done and tested, but need some improvements.

articleTitle: Enhancing Outdoor Warehouse Operations: Design and Development of GPS and Compass-Guided Automatic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of modern manufacturing, the imperative to achieve efficiency, precision, and adaptability has driven the integration of cutting-edge technologies. Amid these advancements, the Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) has emerged as a transformative catalyst, seamlessly merging robotics and navigation systems to bolster factory operations. As an inconspicuous workforce, the AGV adeptly oversees intricate tasks, effortlessly navigating material distribution pathways and delivering finished products. However, the prevailing high cost of commercially available AGVs poses a substantial challenge for small and medium-sized factories. To address this issue, this research endeavors to design and construct a low-cost AGV with a specialized focus on material transportation beyond factory confines. The foundation of the AGV’s navigation system is established through a fusion of diverse sensors and actuators. Leveraging the Ublox NEO6MV2 GPS device for location acquisition and complemented by a compass sensor for orientation determination, the AGV charts its course. Movement is dictated by calculating heading errors for feedback control, eschewing conventional PID methods. Motor speed modulation is achieved by harnessing PWM generated through a closed-loop PID control system. The AGV is enhanced with an obstacle avoidance system, enriching its navigational capabilities. This research underscores the pursuit of a low-cost AGV solution to mitigate financial barriers faced by smaller factories. By employing an amalgamation of sensor technologies and refining navigational strategies, the study’s outcomes aim to pioneer an accessible AGV model tailored for external material transportation. Ultimately, this research contributes to democratizing automation and enhancing the viability of advanced manufacturing processes.

articleTitle: Multilabel Sentiment Analysis Of Hate Speech Using The Combination Of Indo Bert Lite And Bidirectional Lstm-Cnn Methods With Grid Search Hyperparameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: According to a survey conducted by the Human Resources Research and Development Agency Kominfo in 2023, there were around 60,4% of social media users in Indonesia. However, there were negative messages or opinions on social media that could be hate speech. To classify the sentiment of netizens, whether it contains hate speech content, it can be seen from the terms posted. The labels used are multilabel based on emotion wordsThis study aims to conduct a multilabel sentiment analysis on hate speech. This study used a combination of pretrained indoBert models, BiLSTM-CNN and Hyperparameter Grid Search. The dataset used to train the model is a collection of 13,169 Indonesian-language tweets with 12 labels. The test results with the combination of the models already mentioned, obtained the highest hamming score in the test set was 72.61% with the best hyperparameter being a batch size of 90, with an epoch of 50, a dropout rate model of 0.2, a neuron model of 30, and the Adamax optimizer.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review: User Acceptance Analysis of Digital Banking Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Currently, the existence of digital banking is increasingly being recognized by the people of Indonesia, so that more and more companies or the banking sector are competing to provide digital banking technology. Much research on the analysis of user acceptance of digital banking applications can assist related parties in improving digital banking services. Thus, it is necessary to have a literature review related to the analysis of user acceptance of digital banking applications so that information can be classified systematically. This study aims to identify and analyze the latest research related to the analysis of user acceptance of digital banking applications from 2019-2023 using the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method. The results showed that the type of digital banking application that was most widely studied was Jenius, while the method and statistical method used for analyzing user acceptance of digital banking applications was the UTAUT 2 and Multiple Linear Regression & PLS-SEM. In addition, it is known that UTAUT 2 has many advantages over other methods, in where the model is more comprehensive to analyze user acceptance of a technology.

articleTitle: Information Security Failures Measured and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Controls Ranked by General Data Protection Regulation Penalty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Selecting the most important information security controls is a critical and difficult process. Therefore, the decision-making on how to manage risks and threats has to be supported with data-driven performance measurement metrics. This paper identifies and explores the failures and impacts of information security, as well as the most effective controls to mitigate information security risks in organizations. The method of the study was root cause analysis. All year 2020 GDPR penalty cases (n=81) based on misconduct, as defined in GDPR Article 32: “Security of processing” were matched with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls, which were used as failure identifiers in the analysis. As a result, the study presents both, the top 10 most frequent and the top 10 most expensive information security failures corresponding to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls. Furthermore, the study also illustrates the correlation of these controls.

articleTitle: Implementation of Goods Loss Prevention Tools Using Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Loss of product for companies has become commonplace, lost product loss will occur, but if this product loss continues without any prevention, the company will continue to suffer losses. The research method used is the Qualitative Method and the Literary Study Method, namely going directly to the field to make direct observations of the lost products and also utilizing information sources as reference books and scientific articles. The technology used is the EAS (Electronic Article Survival) system, which is a technology that is applied by devices to prevent theft or reduce theft cases from retail stores. The type of EAS used is the Security Tag. With the application of this technology is expected to prevent and reduce the occurrence of product loss at the Supermarket in Ciledug.

articleTitle: Evaluating User Perception of Online Pharmacy Application in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The health sector, including the pharmaceutical sector, is one of those affected by technological evolution. For instance, the industrial revolution 4.0 created a renaissance for community pharmacy services, such as online pharmacy. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the online purchase of goods and services include medicine. The aim of our research was to evaluate user perception of online pharmacy applications in young adult age. An online cross-sectional study was conducted between January 14$^{th}$-March 13$^{th}$, 2022. A 10-item questionnaire with single choice and 5-point Likert scale answers was used and implemented in Google forms. A sampling of 77 respondents from 102 responses was collected. Data analysis used SPSS 25. Results showed the questionnaire was valid and reliable. There were 5 online pharmacy applications that were used by the respondents i.e., HaloDoc, GrabHealth, GoMed, Alodokter, and Good Doctor. Overall, respondents had good positive perception about these applications.

articleTitle: An Analytic Study of Learning Management System in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This article describes the experience of supporting scholars using an e-learning platform. We use Moodle as an interactive existential tool to engage students and motivate them to complete individual assignments. Many universities worldwide are using e-learning platforms, but this is the first time they are using them, and it is a great learning/teaching experience. This paper should be easy to read and understand by showing the importance of using the university’s e-learning platform. It is demonstrated by the behavior of most commonly accessing the homework section and uploading assignments (sending homework) completed after an aggregate of 6.81 views of assignments. Another finding is the number of students who choose to alter the randomly generated passwords sent to them until they enroll in the course. Only 7.5 out of every 1,000 accounts had their passwords changed. Novelty This was done since most students use computers and save their passwords in their browsers, which allows them to log in immediately the following time they use them. There isn’t a single type of assignment suitable for all students. Students may be asked to do some activities independently in specific instances. It’s done after viewing a demonstration, and it’s also done to spark creativity. We do not receive help despite the pipeline. In some circumstances, pupils are expected to complete work alone. It’s done after witnessing a demo, and it’s also done to promote creativity. We don’t get any help despite the pipeline. We solely accept online lesson links

articleTitle: Crude Palm Oil Price Forecasting Based on ECoS-MARS: in Data Science Models
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The crude palm oil (CPO) industry is highly competitive due to fluctuating and unpredictable prices. To accurately predict future CPO prices, a forecasting technique is necessary. This can be achieved through various regression techniques and data mining approaches. This paper proposes a Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS) model, which utilizes the ECoS machine learning algorithm to obtain optimal forecasting values. This research mainly focuses on forecasting CPO prices using the ECoS-MARS approach. The functional basis (BF) validation has yielded an accuracy of 0.0532%. Furthermore, validation has been conducted to achieve accurate forecasting values, resulting in an accuracy of 0.11714%. The best parameter combination for this forecasting model consists of a learning rate of 0.6 for both learning rates 1 and 2, a sensitivity threshold of 0.3, and an error threshold of 0.05.

articleTitle: Unveiling Happiness Disparities: A Machine Learning Approach to City-Village Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Happiness is the core function behind all activities. There are various factors that influence happiness of a person. Generally, we constitute happiness with consumption of goods and items. In this paper, we will try to analyze the factors that influence happiness. Core of this paper is to analyze the comparison of happiness index between cities vs villages. Next objective of this paper is to suggest the approach to live happy and highlight core functions for the same. Extended Neural network is used to obtain the objectives.

articleTitle: Control Improvements of an Electromyography-Based Lower Limb Gait Trainer
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper presents an investigation of a control improvement for an electromyography (EMG)-based gait trainer. Gait impairments can severely affect an individual's mobility and quality of life. EMG-based gait trainers offer a promising solution by utilizing bioelectrical signals to facilitate natural and efficient walking patterns. However, challenges remain in refining control strategies to ensure accurate and intuitive assistance. This paper aims to improve the precision, adaptability, and user experience of EMG-based gait trainers. The proposed control enhancements are validated through experiments to demonstrate significant strides toward more effective gait rehabilitation systems.

articleTitle: XOR Encryption based on Index Value Enumeration used in IoT based Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The use of healthcare-based IOT becomes something that is unavoidable, especially when a pandemic occurs, where a screening process is needed for a person’s condition. This initial condition can be a determinant of further steps to be taken based on these conditions. Healthcare-based IOT can help make it easier for Health in initial checks where this can be done in remote areas and at a relatively low cost. The use of the Safe Entry Station (SES) can assist in determining whether or not a person is healthy, measurements are made with basic things, namely blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate and other things. The results of the test are then sent to the central health institution, where the data will be used for further decision making on the results. For this reason, it is necessary to increase the security of the data sent, to avoid leaks, changes, manipulation and so on. This article discusses the encryption of data sent from Safe Entry Stations to Advanced Health Institutions, the use of XOR-based Encryption, encryption is done with indexvalue formulation of data that is enumerated. The results of this encryption are proven to increase the security of the resulting data from the Safe Entry Station which is sent to the Advanced Health Institute. Testing is done with several tools that are available for free.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Experience in “Haji Pintar” Mobile App: Implementing Human Interface Guidelines through UCD and PACMAD
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The presence of Haji Pintar provides information for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims. Where the congregation can easily get information. The Haji Pintar Appstore has a rating of 2.4, indicating user dissatisfaction. Research focuses on the development of Interface, experience, and Prototype. Maximizing satisfaction and convenience required to redesign, in this study, the User-Centered Design method was used to apply the Human Interface Guidelines which were tested using the People at the Center of Mobile Application Development to improve usability. Testing the designed application prototype, the results obtained were efficiency 0.026 goal/second, very fast qualification, the effectiveness of 96% successfully met the level of effectiveness, satisfaction 2.5 satisfactory category, very good learnability with a value of 96%, memorability efficient, easy to remember with a value of 94.1%, error with a value of 0.7 in the reasonable category, and cognitive load in 23 moderate workload categories.

Author Keywords: People At The Centre Of Mobile Application Development (PACMAD)

articleTitle: Stakeholder Management and Communication Management Plan on E-Government Project
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The use of stakeholder management is crucial for achieving success in projects, specifically within the domain of e-government project consulting. The aforementioned procedure encompasses the identification of persons, organizations, or entities that possess the capacity to exert influence over a project, comprehending their expectations, and evaluating the probable consequences of their involvement. The development of effective management strategies involves the engagement of stakeholders in decision-making processes, the establishment of ongoing contacts, and the resolution of challenges, all with a focus on prioritizing their needs and expectations. Communication Management Plans are of utmost importance as they serve to ensure the implementation of effective communication methods that facilitate the alignment between stakeholders and project objectives. Within the realm of e-government consulting, the process entails actively involving diverse stakeholders, including IT Governance Boards, Project Managers, and other relevant parties. This is achieved by the use of different techniques, such as the regular dissemination of reports on a weekly basis, conducting surveys, carrying out interviews, and facilitating group discussions on dedicated forums. Stakeholder mapping is an effective method for addressing typical obstacles encountered in stakeholder management. This tool facilitates the classification of stakeholders according to their degrees of interest and power, hence enabling the development of customized engagement strategies. The successful execution of projects, particularly intricate endeavors such as e-government, relies heavily on thorough stakeholder management and well-defined communication protocols. The capacity to discern essential stakeholders, comprehend their issues, and develop efficient lines of communication is crucial in attaining project success.

articleTitle: Design and Development of An Automated Mobile Robot for Hospital Care Services
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Robot demand in the clinical sector has significantly increased recently, mostly due to the rising number of COVID- 19 patients. SARS-CoV-2 is mostly spread through close human contact and contact with contaminated objects and surfaces. As a result, the practice of social distancing has become an essential preventive intervention. Due to this, patients must receive medical care with little doctor-patient contact. Robotics are being used in the hospital to protect front-line healthcare personnel from possible coronavirus contamination, while also reducing the need for medical professionals by enabling robots to assume some medical responsibilities to a certain extent. This paper described the design and development process of the automated robot for hospital care services, as well the the testing of this mobile robot movement control using omni wheels.

articleTitle: The Impact of Technological Readiness Factors on User Satisfaction in The Indonesian Local Government Employee Service System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: User satisfaction within a system comes to fruition when their initial expectations align with the system's actual performance and user experiences. This alignment underscores the significance of assessing technological preparedness and potential health risks to measure user contentment. This study addresses a pivotal concern related to a database error, leading to system inaccessibility and redundant performance reporting within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. The primary objective of this research is to evaluate the degree of perceived user satisfaction and the influencing factors within this context. The assessment focuses on the interplay of technological readiness and user health risks. This study employs a quantitative research approach and a purposive sampling method. The research integrates the Expectation Confirmation Model and Technology Readiness Index 2.0, incorporating a novel variable known as "perceived susceptibility." The findings underscore a significant majority of respondents, approximately 96%, expressing satisfaction. Critical determinants of system user satisfaction are identified as perceived usefulness and confirmation. The implications of this research extend to providing insights into enhancing technological readiness to elevate user satisfaction levels within the Indonesian Local Government Personnel Service System. In addition, the results of this study serve as a reference for subsequent research to dig deeper into the subjects explored in this research.

articleTitle: The Success of Higher Education Institutional Policy Is Determined by IT Leadership and IT Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Information Technology (IT) is currently widely used by universities in their success in improving education quality. For this reason, the success of tertiary institutions is generally influenced by IT leadership and IT infrastructure to achieve organizational goals. Leadership is crucial because IT offers enormous benefits for institutions and organizations for capacity building and leadership development. Reviewing the literature to build a broad understanding of IT leadership in organizations, this study adopts a leadership theory that can be used to study how Information Technology can influence and be affected by leadership. This study uses a mixed methods approach, namely using qualitative to conduct interviews on aspects of leadership and quantitative to test the model. This study aims to determine the factors that influence the use of information technology in leadership and infrastructure in tertiary institutions by adopting and adapting several models and theories. Four factors influence IT leadership and IT infrastructure: top management support, systems knowledge, perceived capabilities, and IT strategy and vision. Formal aspects support the development of IT leadership and IT infrastructure; feedback is integrated into development plans and should be treated as a core process for the long-term success of higher education institutions. This research demonstrates the need for further empirical studies that would benefit from a greater understanding of leadership development in IT.

articleTitle: Gender Recognition Based on Face Image Using Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Gender recognition based on facial images is one of the interesting applications in the field of image processing and artificial intelligence. Deep Learning methods, particularly artificial neural networks, have emerged as an effective tool for extracting complex facial features and classifying gender with high accuracy. This research outlines a study that aims to develop an employee gender recognition system based on facial images using Deep Learning methods. The method used in this study proposes the inceptionV3 model as well as the OpenCV and matplotlib libraries in Python in involving the collection of facial image datasets covering different genders with a total of 1024 facial images, each with 40 attributes. This dataset was used to train a deep artificial neural network to recognize patterns and features that are unique to male and female genders and validated. Furthermore, the artificial neural network was tested with a dataset of never-before-seen facial images to evaluate the performance of the system. The results show that the InceptionV3 Deep Learning model has great potential in gender recognition based on facial images. The developed system was able to achieve a high level of accuracy in classifying the gender of individuals from facial images with a total accuracy of 94.8% against the test data, even in complex situations such as variations in facial expressions and lighting.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Government Aid Recipient Using SMART Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Decision Support systems have been widely implemented in various problem areas. This is due to the advantages of decision support systems in providing alternative solutions based on data and established criteria. Various problems can be solved, including multi-criteria problems. The problem of providing government aid is included in multi-criteria cases. One method that can be used to solve this problem is the use of a Simple Multi-Criteria Rating (SMART) method. This system can provide alternatives to the problem of providing government aid based on 14 criteria. The results of user acceptance testing which was carried out by giving 10 questions resulted in 85.15% of the system being acceptable. This system can provide alternatives to the problem of providing government aid based on 14 criteria. The results of user acceptance testing which was carried out by giving 10 questions resulted in 85.15% of the system being acceptable.

articleTitle: IoT-based Alcohol Detection Prototype for Public Transportation Drivers
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages can reduce a person’s performance in driving, increasing the risk of accidents. By using the latest technology, such as IoT, alcohol content detection for public transportation drivers can be carried out. Here, we proposed the IoT-based prototype using an MQ3 sensor that will detect alcohol content or more from the exhalation of the driver. For real-time monitoring, the device will connect to the company management’s smartphone using Blynk and send the notification via the Internet. We developed the prototype using the Research and development approach. From the evaluation, we can conclude that the prototype can give a fast detection response (3 seconds) if the distance is not more than one centimeter. It will respond in 5 seconds for 3 centimeters distance, and it did not give a response for more than 3 centimeters distance. In the product trial, we used beer (5% alcohol), Red Wine (10% alcohol), Soju (20% alcohol) and Vodka (40% alcohol). The system can also notify management if it detects 5% or more alcohol content.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of P4AI Mobile Apps through User Interface Results and User Experience Surveys
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Profiling For Aptitude Inventory (P4AI) application is an aptitude test developed to determine the capacity of students’ interests and talents. The aptitude profile will help students in setting goals and chosen academic fields so that they can support and predict student success in the future. Profiling For Aptitude Inventory (P4AI) application was created using Flutter framework as the frontend and Flask framework as the backend. This research aims to analyze the results of the user interface and user experience to improve application quality. Based on the analysis results of the UI/UX evaluation survey of the P4AI application, it can be concluded that users tend to agree on the attractiveness of the appearance of the P4AI application. However, there are several indicators and items that need to be improved and developed to increase user satisfaction with the appearance and flow of the application. Therefore, changes have been made to the application to improve the quality of application use.

articleTitle: Relation Classification in Scientific Article Abstracts using SciBERT with Entity Marker
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In recent years, relation classification has become one of the important stages in relation extraction for the construction of a knowledge graph. Relation classification is used to classify the relation of each entity in a text or paragraph. In one paragraph, there will be many entities, so it requires accurate information about the position of entities in the text. To solve this problem, we used entity markers and compared the results with the standard entity. This research proposes two pretrained BERT models, BERT-Base and SciBERT-Scivocab. SciBERT is a BERT model that has been specially trained on scientific datasets, while BERT-Base is trained on general datasets. We tested both models with the SciERC dataset, which is a collection of biomedical and computer science article abstracts. The results of relation classification are annotated in the form of F2-score which in this case is more concerned with recall than precision. The F2 score on the BERT-Base model is 82.33% and the SciBERT-Scivocab model is 83.75% using standard entities, while the F2 score using entity markers on the BERT-Base model is 82.30% and the SciBERT-Scivocab model is 84.18%.

articleTitle: Authenticity Detection for Mechanical Watch Using Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The detection of original products is needed by a brand to maintain the authenticity of goods. This is to prevent goods from being imitated by ensuring the quality of goods to users. The issue presented in this study is how to use HMM to determine the authenticity of watch. At this stage of determining the authenticity of watches, the HMM algorithm is used to look for color matching, tough glass, and the presence of mechanical watch hands. Authenticity standards are carried out using probabilities including emission probability and HMM transition probability. However, before entering processing using the HMM algorithm, the system needs to go through the pre-processing and data training stages to be able to train the system to process mechanical hour data. The thing that influences this research is the distance between the photo object and the camera in the range of $5-20 \mathrm{~cm}$ and not too blurry or vibrating. The results of the research will be in the form of a statement that mechanical watch fall into the Bad, Good, or Tolerance categories. Watches that have a Bad category statement mean they are not fit for sale; Good means worth selling; while Tolerance means it requires manual re-detection. System testing using the black box method in this test obtained an accuracy value of $88 \%$ of the total data testing of 100 mechanical clock images.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Bi-Directional LSTM And Transfer Learning in Correcting Typing Errors on Twitter Social Media Posts
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Typing errors are a behavior that often occurs in communication via short messages or posts on social media platforms. In communicating on social media, many individuals without realizing it often make typing errors that can affect the meaning of sentences. This research will apply a model that can check typing errors using Bi-Directional LSTM and transfer learning which results in the Bi-Directional LSTM model achieving an accuracy of 78% after being trained for 20 epochs with a batch size of 64. On the other hand, the transfer learning model achieves an accuracy of 80% with the same epoch and batch size settings. Furthermore, when the Bi-Directional LSTM model was set with 20 epochs and batch size 64, the accuracy increased to 83%, while the transfer learning model achieved 87% accuracy. Finally, with 20 epochs and a batch size of 64, the Bi-Directional LSTM model achieved 87% accuracy, while the transfer learning model achieved an impressive accuracy of 93%.

articleTitle: Decision Support System Mapping of Information Technology Training for Students with Blind Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Republic of Indonesia Law Number 8 of 2016 explains that a person with disabilities is part of the Republic of Indonesia and has the same rights and obligations. Therefore, social welfare improvement for people with disabilities is necessary. One way to improve social welfare is by providing information technology training. To support information technology training, mapping is needed for appropriate training for people with disabilities. In this research, mapping was carried out for people with visual impairments for technology training. Mapping was carried out using a decision support system, where there was a ranking of each information technology training based on ability. The ranking was analyzed using the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) method. This study focuses on people with visual impairments, and the types of training to be evaluated are Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Photoshop, Scratch Programming, Adobe Illustrator, e-marketing, internet browsing, and social media. The results obtained show the ranking of appropriate information technology training for people with visual impairments.

articleTitle: Solar Powered RT-Bot: River Trash Collecting Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Environmental activists are currently focusing on the issue of waste, particularly the waste found in river areas that eventually ends up in the ocean. To address the problem of floating waste in rivers, this paper presents the development of an RT-Bot, also known as the River Trash Bot. The research encompasses the design of a 3D model, integration of mechanical and electronic components, as well as testing and deployment. The primary objective of this robot is to collect garbage from water bodies or rivers using remote control. It utilizes a rechargeable battery powered by solar panels, promoting sustainable energy utilization. Experimental trials were conducted using three different types of propellers, and the Nets propellers demonstrated the highest accuracy in garbage collection compared to metal fishbone and plastic propellers. The results of this study indicate that the use of a propeller net improves the precision of garbage collection in comparison to both metal and fishbone. The robot has an operational capacity of approximately 1.4 hours. Furthermore, data obtained from the solar panels indicated that the highest voltage of 19.50 volts was recorded at 12:00 noon under hot weather conditions without clouds. The study conclusively demonstrates the robot’s effectiveness in collecting surface garbage in river environments.

articleTitle: Application of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) Algorithm in Gold Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)

authors.preferredName: Ni Luh Wiwik Sri Rahayu Ginantra

abstract: Gold is a precious metal that is in great demand by the public as an investment tool. The survey results stated that 58.5% of the 5.204 respondents chose gold as the most desirable investment. Gold has a fluctuating price. The price of gold can go up and down within a certain period of time. Fluctuations in world gold prices are influenced by economic factors such as supply and demand for gold. Therefore, we need a prediction that is able to estimate the price of gold based on the movement of gold prices in the previous period. This research compares the ability of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) algorithms in predicting gold prices. This research is expected to obtain an algorithm with the best level of accuracy as a material consideration for investors in making investment decisions. The results of this research state that the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) algorithm is better than Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) in predicting gold prices. The best GRU model uses batch size 8 and epoch 50 to obtain an RMSE of 1464.838, while the best LSTM model uses batch size 32 and epoch 50 to obtain an RMSE of 1469.144.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Time Series Methods for Stock Market Index Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The capital market is a means by which companies or similar institutions can trade their various long-term financial instruments. One of the stocks that is much in demand by traders and investors is the stock owned by Bank Central Asia with the stock code of BBCA. BBCA shares during the period 2017 to 2019 always occupy position 2 in the ranking of stocks with the highest frequency of transactions in the banking sector. One of the problems faced by an investor in stock trading activities is volatility, where there will always be price fluctuations. This makes analysis activities very important as a determinant of success in stock trading. One form of analysis that can be done by stock investors is Technical Analysis, but the indicators used in technical analysis still cannot produce results that can describe price movements perfectly. The Time Series analysis method can be used to provide additional information to Technical Analysis because stock data is included in the time series data group. This study aims to find out the results of the implementation of three types of Time Series analysis methods, namely Linear Trend Regression, Exponential Smoothing, and ARIMA on Bank Central Asia stock price index data for the 2020-2022 period and determine the method with the best accuracy level among the three methods. The results of this study indicate that the ARIMA (1,1,0) method produces the smallest RMSE value at 162.9544 so that it has the best accuracy level among the three methods used. The findings of this study are expected to provide input to investors who want to invest capital into stock products and need additional analysis indicators in making investment decisions.

articleTitle: Identification of Plant Types Based on Leaf Image Using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Plants generally consist of roots, stems, and leaves. Plants have various shapes and sizes of leaves that make them difficult to recognize by humans. Therefore, leaf shape can be used as an indicator in determining the identification results of a leaf image. The algorithm used in this research is CNN (Convolutional Neural Network). Tests in this study were carried out in two scenarios: testing based on epoch variants and testing based on data-sharing variants. Based on research using the CNN algorithm, the results obtained an accuracy of 93% in tests based on the epoch variant, and the best performance was obtained from the model with an epoch value of 50. Then, the accuracy obtained was 93%. Meanwhile, in testing based on data variance, the best performance was obtained by dividing the data 90:10 (540 training data and 60 testing data) with an average result of 93% accuracy, 97% precision, 93% recall, and 95% f1-score.

articleTitle: Automatic Buffalo Feeding and Monitoring System Using NodeMCU ESP8266 based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Thailand, primarily an agricultural country with most of its population engaged in farming, relies significantly on buffalo raising to perform essential agricultural tasks such as plowing, threshing, milling, pushing, and transporting produce. Buffaloes are preferred due to their convenience and cost-effectiveness compared to tractors. This study introduces an automated buffalo feeding system, that uses Internet of Things (IoT) technology. As an initial step, the design of electronic, mechanical, and software circuits is carried out. With an ESP8266 NodeMCU serving as an RFID sensor reader and a 12V DC motor acting as an actuator, the system enables precise and automated feeding of buffaloes based on their individual identification and feeding needs. The HTTP communication protocol is used to connect sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and servers. Black box testing validates the system’s efficiency and successful execution of all scenarios. IoT integration enables seamless monitoring of each buffalo’s diet, facilitating future development and analysis of feeding patterns for distinct buffalo categories.

articleTitle: Smart Parking System With Background Subtraction Algorithm Using Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) Technology on Raspberry Pi 4
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: As the number of vehicles on the roads continues to rise, finding suitable parking spaces has become a major concern for drivers. Many drivers face frustration due to the lack of information about available parking spots, resulting in fatigue and wasted time. This research aims to address this issue by developing an intelligent parking system. The system employs object detection technology using a camera connected to a Raspberry Pi 4 and is complemented by a Progressive Web App (PWA) for easy access across different platforms. The study follows a research and development approach, incorporating agile methodologies for system development. Through this application, users can effortlessly check the availability of parking spaces using their preferred devices. Consequently, drivers will no longer have to spend time manually searching for parking spots. Furthermore, the application is integrated with Socketio to provide real-time data updates and supports non-cash payments to expedite the transaction process.

articleTitle: Component Level Design in Learning-Based Video Games
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Technological developments have opened up new opportunities in innovative learning approaches. Video games are not only considered as a mere form of entertainment, but also as an effective learning tool. This article aims to provide important insights for educators and game developers in designing component level designs in learning-based video games. The method we use is systematic analysis of literature (SLR), we collect and analyze various studies that have been conducted to understand how to design component levels in video game-based learning. The findings from the analysis of this literature review indicate that there are several good design level components that can help learning in video games. The precise level layout makes it easier for players to understand concepts, exploration, and strategies. The difficulty level is adjusted according to the player’s ability.

articleTitle: Adopting Five Planes Framework for Developing User Interface based on User Experience Aspects
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: E-commerce shows a form of change in buying and selling activities carried out with the various advantages offered. Unlike the marketplace, having an e-commerce application itself is expected to increase the brand awareness of a product to its target customers. This study aims to determine the level of usability of an e-commerce website and to develop it in terms of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) with the final result of interface design recommendations. The development method used is the five planes framework with a cognitive walkthrough and a user experience questionnaire (UEQ) as an assessment for usability testing. The results show that with the recommended design, the efficiency level increased to 89%, the effectiveness level increased to 92%, and scored “excellent” in all six aspects of UEQ’s assessment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Influencing the Use of QRIS on Museum Visitors with the Extended TAM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research aims to determine what factors significantly influence public acceptance of using QRIS as a means of payment at museums in Indonesia. It needs to be done because, up to now, only two museums in Indonesia use transactions using QRIS as a payment transaction tool that has been established in Indonesia. This study uses the TAM model with several variables such as Efficiency and Security (ES), reduced cost (RC), Perceived Usefulness (PU), Perceived Ease of Use (PEU), Attitude Towards (ATT), and Behavioral Intention (BI). By calculating the sample using the Krejci formula, 384 respondents were obtained from 2 museums in Jakarta. The research technique used is non-probability sampling with purposive sampling. Analysis was performed with Smart Partial Least Square software (SmartPLS) version 3. Based on the results of the study that has been carried out, several variables that have accepted the use of QRIS are Efficiency Security (3,105), Perceived Ease of Use (5,527), and Perceived Usefulness (2,948), while Attitude Toward variable (0,349) and Reduced Cost (0,059) does not. From the above, it can be concluded that if a QRIS is to be implemented as a payment transaction tool in various museums in Indonesia, then museum visitors will consider security in transactions (Efficiency Security), Ease of Transaction (Perceived Ease of Use) and Benefits obtained (Perceived Usefulness). Even though this research only involves two museums in Jakarta, this can be the basis for implementing QRIS in museums other than Jakarta to help managers and visitors improve museum management in a good way.

articleTitle: Evaluation of User Satisfaction with Mobile-Based E-Wallet Platforms Using the Delone & Mclean Model (Case Study: Sakuku)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: User satisfaction will increase when the quality of information released from the information system also increases. Based on data collected by iPrice and Jakpati, 26% of the total 1,000 respondents said they chose e-wallets as a payment method when making online purchases. Sakuku is an e-wallet platform issued by PT. Bank Central Asia (BCA) to pay for purchase transactions, top up balances, and make other financial transactions. However, this application, which was founded in 2015, in fact still occupies the eighth position out of ten e-wallets in research conducted by Populix as the most frequently used e-wallet in Indonesia and has several problems such as applications that are difficult to use and easy to close suddenly or forcefully closed., transaction codes that cannot be used during transaction processing, slow problem handling by customer service, registration processes that often fail, balances that are not included when top up and so on. The purpose of this study is to determine the level of success of the application and determine the variables that most influence the end user satisfaction of the Sakuku e-wallet application. This study uses a quantitative approach using the DeLone and McLean model and the addition of the trust variable. The population of this study is users of the Sakuku e-wallet application in Jabodetabek using purposive sampling as a sampling technique. There were 206 respondents who were used as research samples. PLS-SEM is used as an approach to data analysis with SmartPLS 3.2.9 tools. The results of this study indicate that several variables have a significant influence on the success of the application. Of the 10 hypotheses tested, 1 hypothesis was rejected, namely the quality of information on usage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Website Quality Using Webqual 4.0 Method and Importance Performance Analysis (IPA)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Currently, many institutions provide virtual training and internships. One of the organizers is Rakamin Academy. Through the Virtual Internship Experience (VIX) Program website, it provides programs that the community needs. However, there are still challenges in implementing the VIX. Researchers are interested in knowing the effect of website quality on VIX program user satisfaction and identifying indicators that are priorities for improvement. The website quality analysis method uses Webqual 4.0. Apart from using Webqual 4.0, the researcher also uses Importance Performance Analysis (IPA). Data analysis using IBM SPSS version 25 software. The research results show that the variables usability quality, information quality, service interaction quality, and visual quality have a positive influence on user satisfaction of the VIX program at Rakamin Academy, both partially and simultaneously. Overall, the service interaction quality variable shows the largest negative gap value, while the other variables exceed user expectations. By using the IPA quadrants, priority recommendations for improvements to the service interaction quality variable are produced.

articleTitle: Implementation of Preprocessing in Text Summarization Techniques for Indonesian Language Documents Using the Flax T5 Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: As information develops, many individuals or communities change their habits in obtaining information, which is usually consumed in large quantities, so that sometimes it is difficult to understand, it becomes easier to get information in summary form, so this research applies the text summarization technique to Indonesian language documents using the Flax T5 model. is the development of transformer-based google. The results of this study are the use of parameters from the Flax T5 model that can affect the performance of text summaries, evidenced by the number of epochs 20, batch size 64 producing ROUGE-1 of 0.24. the ROUGE-2 value is 0.3 and the ROUGE-L value is 0.31, while the epoch value is 60, batch size 128 makes ROUGE-1 0.35, ROUGE-2 value is 0.38 and the ROUGE-L value is 0.36. while the epoch value of 100 and the batch size value of 256 produce a ROUGE-1 value of 0.5, a ROUGE-2 value of 0.54, and a ROUGE-L value of 0.55. However, this model has limitations in text lengths of more than 150 because it will make the training time so long that it is highly recommended not to use text lengths that exceed 150 words.

articleTitle: Evaluating SVOD User Experiences: Insights from The UEQ Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Technology is evolving very rapidly every year. The film industry is affected by technological advances. Subscription videoon-demand (SVOD) or film-watching service Application is rapidly growing, especially in Indonesia. According to the survey, the most popular apps in Indonesia are Disney+ Hotstar and Netflix. But, those bad reviews on the Google Play store on both apps are still frequently obtained. This study aims to compare film-watching applications moving in the same field and find out the value of the user experience of each app being surfed using the user experience questionnaire (EUQ) method. This method consists of six parameters: Attractiveness, Perspicuity, Efficiency, Dependability, Stimulation, and Novelty. It can accurately and effectively evaluate the experience perceived by the user towards a product. Google Forms are used to collect the data online from both application users. Then, we used the UEQ Analysis Tool to analyze the data. We got 122 respondents during our research time. Both applications mostly have positive scores for all parameters. The Disney+ Hotstar app got more than 0.8 scores for all parameters. The Netflix apps got lower than −0.8 for the novelty and positive score for the last parameters. We conclude that the Disney+ Hotstar app is better than the Netflix novelty scale. Netflix users may perceive it as a standard or conventional solution without many unique or innovative elements.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness and Efficiency of A Website Using Cognitive Walkthrough Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The quality of a website is said to be good if the display has a combination of elements consisting of system design, content on the system, navigation, and functionality on the system so that the website layout is aligned and balanced. Therefore, an assessment is needed from the user side who wants to see if the website is good or still some bugs that can be fixed later. The method used in this research is a cognitive walkthrough, which involves users in assessing the usability of a website. This research aimed to identify and analyze problems that users face accessing the sampled website and also provide recommendations and suggestions for improving the user interface. The results show that the proportion the effectiveness and efficiency obtained by 64% and 66.31%. It is below the standard set by Jeff Sauro of 78%. Besides that, the majority of participants failed in the fourth task scenario (ST4: finding address and contact us information) and found errors in the second task scenario (ST2: searching for company profile information) and the third scenario (ST3: finding product information). It was found that the proportion of error rates in the ST2 and ST4 are 40% and 100%. Moreover, the ST1 and ST3 task scenarios have error rates below average, by 0% and 13.33% respectively.

articleTitle: Impact of Massive Tourist and Vehicles Flow on Air and Water Quality of Uttarakhand
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The degradation of air quality in hilly regions due to the influx of tourists and vehicular traffic is a significant global concern. This research focuses on assessing the impact of these factors specifically in the Uttarakhand region. While various other factors contribute to the problem, our study aims to quantify the proportion of these two inputs. To achieve this, we employ data collection methods and develop innovative deep learning techniques tailored to the issue. The novelty of our work lies in the application of these novel methods to address the problem at hand. By conducting this study, researchers have gained insights into the extent of the impact and its implications for the region. The findings of our research contribute to the existing body of knowledge and provide valuable information for policymakers, environmentalists, and stakeholders involved in addressing air quality concerns in hilly regions.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Successful Implementation of Contact Tracing Application Using the Delone & McLean Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: PeduliLindungi was an application made by the government to track the spread of the COVID-19 virus. However, applications that have been released since 2020 still have several weaknesses, such as frequent system errors, difficulty getting OTP codes, no vaccine certificates appearing, difficulties registering vaccines, and problems with user trust in using the PeduliLindungi application. The purpose of this study was to determine the factors that influence the successful implementation of the PeduliLindungi application. This study uses a quantitative approach. The model used in this study was the Delone & McLean model with the variables of information quality, service quality, system quality, usage, user satisfaction, and net profit, and this research adds system trust variables. The population in this study were Android/iOS mobile phone users with the PeduliLindungi application, using a purposive sampling technique. The data analysis process used the PLS-SEM approach with SmartPLS version 3.2.9 tools. The results of the research hypothesis showed that of the 10 hypotheses tested, there were two variables that were rejected, namely the quality of the system for use and the quality of the system for user satisfaction. Factors of information quality, service quality, system trust, user satisfaction, and usage have a significant effect on the successful implementation of the application as a COVID19 service application.

articleTitle: Leveraging IT for Optimizing Employee Performance via Work Culture and Quality Management in BUMD Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research examines the impact of work culture and quality management on employee commitment and performance within BUMD enterprises, focusing on the DKI Jakarta Trade and Industry Group. We surveyed 200 respondents using proportional random sampling and employed structural equation modelling (SEM) with AMOS version 22 for analysis. Our findings reveal that work culture significantly and positively influences employee commitment, and this commitment, in turn, positively affects employee performance. In the specific context of BUMD DKI Jakarta Trade and Industry Group, employee commitment emerges as a pivotal driver of performance. Additionally, we identify employee commitment as a mediating factor in the relationship between quality management and employee performance, while work culture’s impact on performance remains undiminished. These results suggest that management should prioritize strategies to enhance employee commitment through effective quality management to improve performance within BUMD DKI Jakarta Trade and Industry Group. Nevertheless, it is essential to recognize the continuing relevance of work culture and quality management, albeit with a relatively minor impact on performance. We recommend further research to explore additional mediating variables for a deeper understanding of optimizing employee performance.

articleTitle: The Solar Panels Cleaning Robot Control via IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In this research, researchers explore the development of IoT-controlled solar panel cleaning robots aim to enhance the efficiency of the robot’s moving system and solar panel maintenance.
