Using differential kinematics, the research calculates robot’s motion and navigation. The control system, administered by a microcontroller, integrates IoT technology for remote management. Simulations demonstrate the robot successfully cleaning a 100cm x 165cm path in 110 seconds. This work lays the foundation for future autonomous solar panel cleaning robots.

articleTitle: The SEM-PLS Analysis for Testing Questionnaire: Software Developer Productivity Based on Religiosity and Work Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The growth of the internet has led to the use of the internet in various ways, especially when the COVID-19 pandemic occurred and hit Indonesia in 2020. There was a change in human behavior from initially offline to online. This certainly makes humans more efficient and effective when carrying out their activities. All of this requires some kind of application or information system, and this, of course, requires someone who has programming skills, known as a software developer. Based on literature studies, not only are there qualified technical factors that a software developer must have to have good productivity, but it turns out that internal factors influence the software developer’s work and ultimately affect productivity. This research uses religiosity as an internal factor that influences software developer work behavior, referring to the results of an interview with a software developer who felt more focused and calmer when working after carrying out religious activities. Researchers used SEM-PLS to process questionnaire data. The results of data processing show that the research instrument used is very good at representing the proposed model, but it was found that the religiosity factor does not have a positive effect on work behavior, but work behavior has a positive effect on software developer productivity.

articleTitle: Vehicle Number Plate Recognition in Intelligent Transportation System using YOLO v8 and EasyOCR
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Intelligent Transporttion System (ITS) provides economic benefits to business practices in the public or private sector. The benefit of implementing ITS is vehicle plate recognition. Number plates can be used for various things, for example, detecting when a user violates rules. Vehicle number plate detection is a process of image processing captured by a traffic camera. It is rather difficult to obtain high accuracy in the case of Vehicle Plate Recognition. To develop a motor vehicle plate recognition system, it is necessary to implement YOLO v8, which is useful in detecting motor vehicle plate objects, and easyOCR for reading characters from vehicle plates. YOLO v8 has better accuracy than previous versions in detecting motor vehicle plate objects with EasyOCR to read motor vehicle serial numbers. The accuracy obtained from this system reaches 95%.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review: Key Management Service For Securing Encryption Key
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper utilizes the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method to investigate and analyze the key management services employed for securing encryption keys, as well as the benefits of these methods. The research findings support the conclusion that SLR is an effective approach for studying user acceptability of widely explored E-Wallet apps, wireless sensor networks (WSNs), and key generation centers (KGCs). Data regarding the names of encryption keys was collected during the period from 2019 to 2023. Key Management Systems (KMS) are extensively utilized to comprehend and evaluate the factors influencing the Key Management Service for Securing Encryption Key. The analysis focuses on four main topics: the names of encryption keys, methods used for encryption, statistical methods, and the Key Management Service. Comparative analysis emerges as the most commonly employed statistical approach.

articleTitle: Analyze and Measure Website Quality Using WebQual 4.0, Importance Performance Analysis Methods and GTMetrix
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Ma’had Al-Jami’ah UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta is one of the Technical Implementation Units (UPT) of UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta using the website as a source of information about student accommodation. The web page contains Ma’had’s profile information, Ma’had’s location and the dormitory registration form. When conducting research, there were problems with web quality, namely slow website performance, and the information presented on the website was not up-to-date and detailed. The research was conducted to measure and analyze the Ma’had Al-Jami’ah website to improve service quality using the WebQual 4.0 and IPA methods and to test website performance using Gtmetrix. The research was conducted with 84 student respondents living in dormitories during the 2022-2023 period. The results of data analysis using WebQual 4.0 and Relevance-Effectiveness Analysis show that the dimensions of usability, information quality and service interaction quality have an average index of 81%, namely website quality in the good category. And the level of values and expectations of website users achieves user satisfaction with a value of 137%, but the indicators of ease of learning, ease of understanding and navigation have not reached user satisfaction. The results of website performance testing using GTmetrix have reached a fairly good web category, namely Grade C. The research results are expected to help Ma’had Al-Jami’ah management to improve the quality and efficiency of the Ma’had Al-Jami’ah website.

articleTitle: Server Cloud Based Security Surveillance Systems: a Design Science Research
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In this research, the author addresses the prevalent issues faced by users of cloud services, especially those using Peer-to-Peer (P2P) technology, such as connection losses, security concerns, and poor video quality. The study does not delve into the complex problems at the data center level but instead proposes a novel Design Science Research approach. This new method, tested with five clients in varied locations, utilizes port forwarding to establish a direct server-client connection, bypassing traditional P2P frameworks. The results show that this approach significantly improves quality over the P2P system. Feedback from clients before and after the experiment indicates a positive response to this new method. This research offers insights into overcoming P2P-related issues in cloud services and contributes to the development of cloud-based server science, presenting a cost-effective, independent alternative to data center-dependent P2P services, with plans for ongoing research in this area.

articleTitle: User Acceptance Analysis of Online Food Delivery Service Application Using The UTAUT 2 Modification Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: ShopeeFood is an online food delivery service through the ShopeeFood feature in the Shopee application, customers can place food orders which will then be delivered by ShopeeFood driver partners to the front of the customer’s house. In its application, there are still some obstacles experienced by users such as limited features, applications experiencing errors or slow loading, and orders that have been completed but not received by customers, this can have a direct impact on customer loyalty to the company. Therefore, there is a need for research that aims to determine users’ perceptions of ShopeeFood services and find out what factors affect the acceptance of ShopeeFood service users. The model used in this study is the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT 2) model with the addition of two variables, namely Perceived Trust and Perceived Value. This study uses a quantitative approach, distributing online questionnaires with 33 questions and analyzing data using SmartPLS version 3.2 tools. Based on the hypothesis that has been proposed. As a result of the 11 proposed hypotheses, 2 hypotheses were declared insignificant and rejected, this means that the existence of business expectations, supporting resources, the feeling of pleasure in using technology, habits, trust in a technology and the perceived benefits of users affect the intention to use technology and the existence of supporting resources, habits in using technology and intentions to use technology. a technology affects the frequency of users in using a technology.

articleTitle: Reducing Internet Gaming Disorder in Adolescents: Analysis of Gaming-Contingent of Self-Worth, Loneliness and Peer Attachment
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study aims to predict factors determining internet gaming disorder in adolescents. We test the variables of gaming contingent of self-worth, loneliness, and peer attachment. The sample used was 211 adolescents in Jakarta- Indonesia, using a non-probability sampling technique, namely purposive sampling. The instruments are the Internet Gaming Disorder Scale-Short Form (IGDS9-SF), Gaming-Contingent of Self-Worth (GCSW), De Jong Gierveld Loneliness Scale, and Inventory Parent and Peer Attachment to measure Peer Attachment. The results showed that there was a significant effect between gaming-contingent self-worth, loneliness, and peer attachment on internet gaming disorder. The validation-seeking dimension of the gaming-contingent of self-worth variable has a significant effect where individuals may suffer from a decrease in self-worth due to the cessation of gaming. In contrast, the emotional loneliness dimension of the loneliness variable has a significant effect where individuals experience feelings of separation, parental abandonment, or parental divorce, significantly affecting internet gaming disorder.

articleTitle: Green Energy Harvest Monitoring of Watering System for Smart Farming Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The development of electronics, computers, and information technology is very rapid. Still, in several developing and underdeveloped countries, certain groups, including farmers, have not felt significantly the benefits of these technological advances. One of the farmers’ problems is if there is a drought where the rice plants need water, but there is no rain, and the water supply from the river is insufficient, so the rice production process decreases, or the harvest even fails. Previous research stated that in India, most of the population, 70% of whom live in rural areas and are very dependent on agriculture, and research in Indonesia in 2019 showed that in 2017 44% of the population lived in rural areas with most of their profession being farmers. This article proposes to create a groundwater pump system for irrigating crops, especially rice. Groundwater pumps in rice fields far from fuel and electricity supply facilities are a problem. Therefore, using solar energy (PV) and wind energy (WT) is an effective and efficient alternative. A groundwater pump system can be placed in rice fields using batteries, battery energy obtained from photovoltaic (PV) solar panels, or wind energy using a wind turbine (WT). This article contributes to an experiment in making a water pump system by utilizing green energy from PV and WT to provide a plant irrigation system in rice fields. The energy source system can be monitored, and the water pump system can be controlled wirelessly using IoT technology. The experiments in this research use devices that represent the energy and water pump systems at a minimum. The experimental results show that the proposed system works well and can be implemented in a real rice field irrigation system.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Leg Splint Rehabilitation Monitoring System via IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The advancement of medical technology is essential to patient treatment monitoring and healthcare provider administration including telemedicine therapy, wearable devices and healthcare application. This paper proposed a novel of designed and development of monitoring of a leg splint using Internet of Things (IoT) to control and regulate the temperature of the splint. The system consists of an ESP8266 microcontroller, DHT11 sensors, isolation MOSFETs, silicone heater pads, and a web application. The system can be used to monitor and evaluate the patient's performance during the rehabilitation process and enable them to recover faster. The system architecture incorporates Firebase, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Firebase is used to provide authentication, database, and messaging services to the web application. Anto.io is used to establish communication with the microcontroller using the MQTT protocol. The system was evaluated using black box testing, and the results showed that it can function successfully and meet all conditions. The temperature testing at shin, instep, and sole temperatures were 36.2, 36.5, and $37 ^{\circ}\text{C}$, respectively. Sensors provide real-time temperature control system data to the GUI. A mobile phone using IoT may manage the remote control system's test result to monitor and assess the patient's leg splint's performance to maintain a steady temperature according to requirements. This rehabilitation gadget helps patients improve their range of motion, improve their circulation, and recover faster. The proposed system has the potential to revolutionize the field of rehabilitation medicine by providing a more effective and efficient way to monitor and treat patients.

articleTitle: Development of a PID Controller-Based Portable Seeder Design for Corn Seeds
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Corn is a major crop in Thailand and plays a crucial role in feeding people locally and being sold to other countries. Because of its importance, farmers focus a lot on growing corn. Nowadays, many farmers are growing corn to earn more money from their land. As more land is used for corn, there’s a growing need for new ways to plant the seeds. This is where a special machine comes in, a seeder that carefully places corn seeds in the ground according to how they should be planted in fields where corn is grown. In one seeding pass, the machine will press the center and form two rows of mounds with a distance of 25-50 cm between them. In these two mounds, corn seeds will be placed at intervals of 6-8 cm for each row. The design of this seeder machine is made portable so that it can adapt to all types of tractors used as propulsion.

articleTitle: Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease in Resonance Imaging Images Using Machine Learning with the Convolution Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is one of the most common types on disease in the elderly, which was characterizing by damage to the brain and can affect memory capacity, speech and behavior. One way to detect Alzheimer’s disease is to use magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, the proses of detecting using MRI images still requires manual interpretation which is time consuming and difficult for all doctors to do. Therefore, we need a method that can help simplify and speed up the process of detecting Alzheimer’s disease. Machine learning, especially the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) method, is a method that has the ability to manage and analyze large and complex data and take 2D images as input. In this research, the CNN method was using with the efficienctNetB0 architectural model. Then the model that has been train will be implementing into a simple web application. The results of this study managed to achieve a very high level of accuracy, which is equal to 99%. In addition, the model in this research is able to provide consistent and stable results. This research shows that the use of CNN with the EfficientB0 model is very effective in detecting Alzheimer’s disease on MRI images. These high accuracy results demonstrate the important potential of machine learning approaches in the early diagnosis of this disease. It was hoped that this research can contribute to the development of more accurate and efficient diagnostics aids, which can improve the management and care of Alzheimer’s disease in patients in the future.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition of Sundanese Dialect Using Convolutional Neural Network Method with Mel-Spectrogram Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In Indonesia, the Sundanese language is known for its diverse dialects. The distinction between the Bantenese and South Sundanese dialects lies in their usage of words, which can give the impression of shouting. These dialectal differences in pronunciation frequencies can lead to misunderstandings. This study utilized Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and mel-spectrogram to do speech recognition of Sundanese dialects. Mel-spectrogram is a method for extracting features from a sound. It has advantages because it offers sound information to our models that is comparable to what a person would experience, and produced visual representations of the sound frequency spectrum as pictures for these speech data. Furthermore, CNN used as the speech recognition model from these spectrogram images. The research findings proved that mel-spectogram and CNN combination successfully identifies and distinguishes Sundanese dialects. The CNN model, utilizing a filter configuration of 32-32-64-64 on a dataset comprising 50 Bantenese dialect voice samples and 50 South Sundanese dialect voice samples, achieves 93.75% of training accuracy and 95.00% of testing accuracy. This study will help indonesian people to recognize different dialects of Sundanese dialects and reduce misunderstanding between ethnics in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Quick Response Mobile Payment Adoption Using Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of The Technology Model Development
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper serves as an initial study for an ongoing research project that focuses on user intentions regarding mobile payment using QR codes. The model employed is UTAUT, with additional variables of risk, cost, and security. The objective of this research is to analyze the user intentions towards the mobile payment system through QR codes, considering the increasing population of mobile payment users. The sampling technique uses purposive sampling with the data consists of information from 235 users across various regions in Jakarta, analyzed using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLSSEM) approach. The results indicate that 3 out of 8 hypotheses were rejected. Overall, the accepted hypotheses provide valuable insights to researchers regarding the importance of utilizing mobile payment via QR codes while considering aspects of risk, cost, and security.

articleTitle: Enhancing English Students’ Writing Skills with Technology Tools: A Qualitative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The advancement of technology has an impact on teaching, including English writing. This study explores students’ points of view about the impact of technology tools development on their writing skills. This study used qualitative methodology by using questionnaires and interviews. This study engaged students in a higher education of Islamic University in Indonesia consisting of 50 English students. The findings showed that technology tools developments positively and negatively impact students’ writing skills. This study highlights the positive impacts of technology tools developments on students’ writing skills, which are improving students’ writing quality, gaining vocabulary knowledge, and identifying errors more easily. Besides, this study underlined that the negative impacts of technology tools developments on students’ writing skills are laziness and overreliance. Students thought that technology tools did all the writing assignments, which hampered their writing skills. Further, this study highlights that students can enhance their writing skills based on the good impact and avoid the bad impact. By understanding the impact of technology tools development, this study highlights the necessity to have the proper guidance using technology in supporting students’ writing skills.

articleTitle: Implementation of Fuzzy K-Nearest Neighbor Method in Dengue Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) is a condition brought on by infection with the dengue virus. DHF is a severe illness with hemorrhagic clinical signs that can result in shock and death. One of the four viral serotypes of the genus Flavivirus is responsible for DHF. DHF symptoms include fever, joint pain, red skin patches, and others that are similar to those of other illnesses. So that there are no errors in illness prediction, strong accuracy and accuracy are required when classifying DHF patients or not. The Fuzzy K-Nearest Neighbor (FKNN) method is used in this study to classify dengue sickness in order to obtain the best classification outcomes. In this investigation, k was searched for eight times, with values of 3,5,7,9,11,13,15, and 20. Each K's accuracy statistics are 75.15, 75.16, 77.58%, 79.51%, 85.01%, 78.14%, and 75.20 percent. K = 13, which has an accuracy score of 85.01%, yields the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Implementation of the K-means Clustering Algorithm for Targeting Ads. Case Study: IBM Watson Analytics Car Insurance Customer Data
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Online business can increase sales in their business by implementing a Targeting Ads, marketing strategy that utilizes customer data segmentation. To get customer data that has been collected, in Machine Learning there is an algorithm that can be used for customer data segmentation, namely K-Means Clustering. The K-Means Clustering algorithm was chosen because of its ability to group data based on similarity. This study uses a dataset of car insurance customers from IBM Watson Marketing which includes the variable Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) as the dependent variable. The purpose of this research is to provide study references that can be implemented in marketing channels for online businesses that want to increase their profits. The results of this study indicate that the use of the K-Means Clustering algorithm produces different customer groups based on their characteristics so that it is easy and more efficient to get input data in Targeting Ads. Future development of this research may include using local datasets to find out whether there are differences in segmentation results and creating a system for implementing the K-Means algorithm for customer data segmentation that can be used by end users.

articleTitle: Feedback Control System for Angular Position Locking Fork of Forklifts
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research article proposes feedback control-based position control method for the Fork that effectively locks its position to prevent the pallet from slipping out. The proposed operation involves calculating the Forward Kinematics of the Fork to determine the angle adjustment positions and then installing a stepper motor to control the hydraulic valve and an encoder to receive feedback signals. To ensure stable and precise control, remote control is used for long-distance operation. The feedback signals of the system enable accurate control of the tilt angle of the Fork, which in turn provides precise positioning of the load. As a result, the fork can be effectively controlled and locked in the angle position by remote control. This research shows its importance in the field of forklift technology. It offers practical solutions to the challenges faced in material handling operations. By combining theoretical insights with the PID control mechanism to enhance load stability and prevent accidents.

articleTitle: Proposing a Novel Framework for Prediction of Stock using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Stock prices are highly volatile, dynamic, and non-linear, making it very difficult to predict the exact price at any given time. In addition, stock prices are influenced by several factors, such as political conditions, the global economy, unexpected events, company financial performance, and more. Up to this point, various machine learning techniques have been employed for stock prediction; however, none of these techniques can accurately predict stock prices due to the high volatility in stock prices. Machine learning approaches, such as random forest, SVM, KNN, and logistic regression, represent some of the algorithms used for stock prediction. This paper aims to propose a new framework based on machine learning and deep learning for stock prediction. The prediction relies on the company’s stock fundamentals, past performance, related stocks in the same sector, and other relevant factors.

articleTitle: Optimizing Product Distribution Service Prices: A Fuzzy Mamdani Logic Implementation Case Study at RnD Enterprises Marketing Consultant Office
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the economic process, product distribution is essential for making products available to consumers. Distributors play a crucial role in reaching the target market. However, determining the price for distribution services can be challenging, as distributors often set their own tariff provisions. In this study, the author optimizes product distribution service rates by considering factors such as interest ratio, price per pack, and distribution area coverage, using the Fuzzy Mamdani Logic method. Based on data obtained from the Marketing Consultant Office of RnD Enterprises, the optimized service tariff for an interest ratio of 6.9 pax (medium), a price per package of Rp15000,- (low), and 10 distribution areas (low) is 2% of sales every month. This result is significantly lower than the office’s set rate of 6%. The findings can be utilized as a reference by the office to determine distribution service rates for other products, leading to more informed pricing decisions in the future.

articleTitle: Microfinance Management Strategy Using Poverty Reduction Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Indonesian government is currently trying to overcome the problem of poverty for every citizen. Poverty alleviation is the most significant thing and has continued to increase the government’s commitment since the independence period, from the New Order government to the current government. This study aims to formulate a technology strategy to reduce poverty in Indonesia through financial services cooperatives using the Analytic Network Process (ANP) method. The results showed that the problem variable in poverty alleviation was caused by general conditions based on the identification of the problem in the solution variable; poverty reduction strategies are formulated through a series of actions at the macro and micro levels. The novelty of this research is the use of the Tawhid approach and incorporating the Political Economy System variable into the construction of the framework of the Islamic Microfinance Management Strategy Using Poverty Reduction Technology in Indonesia.

articleTitle: IoT based PID Closed Loop Control System for Baby Incubators
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study aims to help control and monitor temperature conditions in infant incubators to remain stable. The control method used in this study is PID, and the system was developed with the concept of the Internet of Things (IoT) so that it can be controlled remotely via an Internet network. This system has several main components: temperature sensor, microcontroller, Wi-Fi module, and server. The temperature sensor measures the temperature inside the incubator, and the data is forwarded to the microcontroller. Then, the microcontroller uses the PID control method to adjust the temperature in the incubator by measuring the difference between the actual temperature in the incubator and the desired set point. The result of this difference becomes an input to the PID. Temperature data and control status are then sent to the server via the Wi-Fi module using the MQTT protocol to be displayed on the web application. Tests were carried out on infant incubators and showed that this temperature control system maintained the incubator temperature properly and provided stable and accurate results. The system response error value is 2.35% with PID, while without PID, the system response error value is 11.76%. In addition, this system also provides convenience in controlling and monitoring incubator temperature via the internet network using a web application with a responsive display.

articleTitle: The Influence of Delayed-hit on Caching Servers Utilizing Conventional Cache Replacement Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: A caching system implemented through online methods like Content Delivery Network (CDN), Proxy, Gateway, or Information-centric Networking (ICN) router is utilized to improve network connectivity. This system utilizes the caching mechanism to store in short-term of data packets obtained from the actual content provider. When the client seeks to access the desired data content, it sends a request to a caching server. Delayed-hit caching, defined as the decline in hit ratio, can be influenced by both the time delay discrepancy between the client’s request packet and the original server’s data packet, as well as the cache’s capacity. This situation arises when the original server’s data packet’s average response time is slower than the average request time of the client’s request packet. Consequently, this paper examines the repercussions of delayed-hit caching in the caching server. It compares two well-known cache replacement algorithms, namely, Least Recently Used (LRU) and First in First out (FIFO). Our findings are proven through simulations conducted with various values of request skewness $(\alpha)$, which indicate the popularity of the requested content following a Zipf distribution against the arrival request time and the response time of the original server.

articleTitle: Implementation of LoRaWAN Routing Protocol in Wireless Sensor Network for Smart Compost System with LoRa Communication Module
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: A new issue has emerged due to the increase in household waste volume. To minimize this waste, several measures have been taken, such as separating inorganic and organic waste. Organic waste can be utilized to create compost. Therefore, the idea of conducting research on a smart compost system, a system for producing compost that can control the composting process to produce high-quality compost that can be accessed through a mobile application, was conceived. This system is based on three parameters: temperature, gas, and humidity. It is designed as a mobile-based system to make it user-friendly for households. The control of this smart composting system is achieved using the concept of a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) to obtain methane gas levels, humidity, and temperature to ensure the composting process is optimal. This monitoring system is integrated with a Telegram application on smartphones for real-time monitoring and data collection of the compost's quality, with the data being stored on a Raspberry Pi through LoRa. The author used a prototyping method in developing the system without neglecting its primary purpose. Based on the research results, which were tested using WSN, an Arduino Uno with MQ-4 and DHT22 sensors was used to monitor the compost quality. The data collected during the composting process is then stored on a local Raspberry Pi server via LoRa as a bridge between the microcontrollers and the server. The smart compost system also achieved a 100% functional value based on User Acceptance Test (UAT) results.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Naïve Bayes Algorithm for Malware Detection on Android Operating Systems with Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The most popular mobile device operating system today is the Android operating system. With so many users of the Android operating system, there are also more crimes, one of which is malware. Malware can infiltrate or damage the system which is certainly very detrimental. During 2021, there were 1,652,521,839 traffic anomaly cases in Indonesia where 62% of these cases were malware infections. Even though it is pretty serious and pervasive, many smartphone users are ignorant and are not aware that their devices have been infected with malware. One way to detect it is by using a machine learning algorithm, namely Naïve Bayes. However, naïve bayes has a weakness, namely, there is no relationship between attributes so it does not improve the performance of the algorithm. Therefore, it is necessary to optimize the problem of selecting and optimizing the features that will be used using the particle swarm optimization algorithm. Based on the research results, the particle swarm optimization algorithm has proven to be quite good at performing feature selection on datasets for the naïve bayes algorithm by achieving 95% accuracy, 95% precision, and 80% recall.

articleTitle: Comparison of Single Exponential Smoothing And Holt-Winter Exponential Smoothing Methods in Sales Commercial Business
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Sales is an important aspect of running a commercial business. To increase sales, it must be accompanied by adequate availability of goods so that consumer needs can be met. However, the challenge in availability is that it is difficult to predict future consumer needs, so overstock and shortages often occur. On the other hand, the organization must be able to provide goods on time. This can be detrimental to the organization. For this reason, many solutions have been developed to overcome this problem, namely by predicting the availability of goods in the future using the single exponential smoothing and Holt-winter exponential smoothing methods. The single exponential smoothing method was used by previous researchers to provide good predictions on annual historical data. However, by using the same data converted into a monthly format, trend and seasonal factors were discovered. Therefore, we perform ex-inventory predictions using a single exponential smoothing method and then compare their performance. Trend and seasonal factors can be handled with the Holt-Winter exponential smoothing method. To determine the best prediction results from both methods for monthly data, we used the MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) method. The research results show that the Holt-winter exponential smoothing method has better performance with a smaller error value compared to single exponential smoothing, namely 1.828%.

articleTitle: Design and Development of the Unicycle Balancing Robot Using Linear Slider
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The developing of a balancing robot, especially unicycle robots, is very challenging due to their complexity, highly non-linearity, and unstable dynamics conditions. Maintaining the stability of the unicycle balancing robot on a single contact point with the ground is much more complicated. To get the successful control of the unicycle balancing robot on the point, the choice of correct mechanical system, electrical system and control algorithm are required effectively. This study is dived into each component and combining to interact with harmonious interaction between the parts. To get rid of the uncertainties of the dynamics system, the usage of Sliding Mode Fuzzy Hybrid Controller plays the most crucial role to obtain the advance control capabilities, adaptability, and flexibility. Even with the inaccurate model and disturbances, the Sliding Mode Control (SMC) deals robustness along with the fuzzy logic control, which deals with non-linearities and uncertainties. By combining these two powerful control theories, stability and precision can be succeeded. Creativity is not only to balancing the linear slider unicycle balancing robot (LSUBR) successfully, but also to drive the unicycle robot technology into the new one. The design novelty of this LSUBR can lead to creating new balancing robots, can be fulfill the possibilities of the industries and control sectors. Also, wireless communication is established between MATLAB and LSUBR. The MQ Telemetry Transport (MQTT) is the main communication channel between the MATLAB MQTT client and LSUBR MQTT client through Raspberry PI MQTT server which is based on Mosquitto. The novelty usage of MQTT communication between LSUBR and MATLAB can help the wireless communication sector for the unicycle balancing robot.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm for Yoga Pose Estimation System as an Exercise Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Yoga is a physical activity that includes meditation using stretching techniques, breathing, balance, and physical flexibility to achieve harmony and harmony between the emotions, soul, mentality, spirituality, and body. Yoga is a popular sport that can make your body and mind healthy and strong. Artificial intelligence technology can be used to gain new experiences in yoga. A healthy lifestyle for people who have changed after the pandemic. Therefore, this study aims to utilize artificial intelligence technology to support public awareness of maintaining a healthy lifestyle by practicing yoga independently. This study uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to classify yoga pose images as exercise assistants that can show whether the yoga poses are appropriate. With a total of 2672 image data containing seven types of yoga pose images, the results show that the CNN algorithm can detect and classify yoga poses well by obtaining an accuracy of 98.91%.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Information Technology in Analyzing the Choice to Attend a Master’s Program in Management during COVID-19: A Financial Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study’s conclusions are twofold. First, it is evident that COVID-19 regulation policies in Indonesia have a substantial impact on how individuals manage their personal finances. The pandemic and associated regulations necessitated changes in financial strategies, reflecting the adaptability of individuals during challenging times. Surprisingly, the influence of these COVID-19 policies did not significantly affect students’ decisions to enroll in the Master’s Program at Pamulang University. Other factors seem to play a more prominent role in determining their enrollment choices. However, the study underscores the crucial role of personal financial management in students’ decisions to pursue a Master’s Program. Their financial well-being and effective financial management significantly influence their choice to continue their education. Throughout the research, the importance of information technology became evident. Technology played a pivotal role in navigating the ”New Normal” in education during the pandemic, highlighting its significance in understanding the interplay between COVID-19 regulations, financial management, and enrollment decisions.

articleTitle: Optimizing Animation of Adolescents learning materials as Moral Education
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Adolescent individuals who take a step towards adulthood need important education about morals and religion, such as fomo that can lead to bad behavior. Fomo has an impact on the success of adolescents’ lives in the future so it requires special attention so that adolescents understand that fomo will damage them. This research aims to create a short animation entitled ‘All because of FOMO’ using 2.5D animation as an effort to optimize learning activities to increase moral awareness in adolescents. The results of this research has been successful, where an average of 90% of users stated that this animation had been successfully made attractive, the colors were appropriate, the audio was good, and it could describe the bad results of FOMO for teenagers.

articleTitle: Development of Case Base Reasoning Recommendation and Sound and Lighting Rental System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study discusses U-PRO Sound & Lighting, a rental company that requires a recording system for inventory, scheduling, and recommending product offerings. A recording is an essential aspect of the rental business. The absence of inventory records causes rental information to be inaccurate and makes internal control less effective. The causes of inventory loss, being left behind, and difficulty scheduling would be problems for the company. Furthermore, developing a quotation requires the owner to locate and open a similar quotation ahead of time to be utilized as a benchmark. Therefore, this research aims to design an integrated inventory and rental system and a recommendation system that help design quotations and control the rental inventory status in real-time. RAD is used as the system development methodology with the Prototyping method. The testing technique used is Black Box Testing. The case-based reasoning method with the similarity formula is applied to get recommendations for similar offer. These research results are a system of inventory, recommendations, and rentals in the form of a website. The inventory and rental system keep track of the items and conditions of all inventory held during and after the event. The inventory checking feature can be used to check inventory availability at a specific time and the recommendation system has been implemented to facilitate the owner in responding to rental requests.

articleTitle: The Automatic Steering Control System for Local Small Tractor by Encoder Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper is presented the automatic steering control of local small tractor. The objective of this paper to study, designed, development and experimental result in term of automatic steering control by using PID control theory. This small tractor type was designed and develops from old engine machine. The purpose of the tractor will be used in rice paddy field. The experimental result was compared the data of encoder during tractor move on the mapping location, all of results was presented between manual and automatic tracking. The overall result was get data collection from rotary encoder model OMRON E6B2-CWZ6C. The steering control system for the tractor was using PID control theory. The experimental result was directed towards on the location mapping via GPS and the data tracking from encoder will convert to GPS data in term of latitude and longitude. The result of manual recording at latitude side was average 14.1344 degree compared with the real data during tractor move was average 14.1342 degree, the average error result was approximately 3 percent. The data at longitude side was average 100.6104 degree to compared with the real data during tractor move was average 100.6012 degree, the average error result was approximately 4 percent. All of the experimental results of the tractor have 97 percent accuracy after improvements the system by using PID control and adjustment the parameter of Kp, Ki and Kd to improve the results of the research.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Financial Implications of Increasing Renewable Energy Penetration in Indonesia’s Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Over the past decade, renewable energy has witnessed a remarkable surge, accounting for a growth from 10% to 20% of Indonesia’s annual electricity generation. This expansion can be attributed to factors such as reduced technology costs and robust governmental backing. Anticipated is a continued rise in the proportion of renewable energy within the total energy generation landscape. Projections from four distinct organizational reference scenarios indicate that by 2030, Indonesia could achieve optimal cost-efficiency in electricity generation, characterized by renewable energy accounting for a fraction of 30% to 350%. This fraction is projected to further intensify, potentially reaching a range of 410% to 620% by 2045. In the pursuit of enhancing the viability of sustainable energy within the ambit of the most economical solutions, this study employs capacity expansion modeling tools. These tools facilitate assessments considering the costs associated with electricity infrastructure development and management. Notably, the relationship between the share of renewable energy generation and system costs demonstrates a nonlinear pattern. Minor deviations from the lowest-cost solution yield negligible cost fluctuations; a mere +/-4% adjustment in renewable energy penetration results in a meager system cost variation of less than 2%. However, more substantial deviations from this baseline can trigger noteworthy escalations in costs. A paramount outcome of augmenting renewable energy penetration is the potential reduction in absolute emissions. Through meticulous analysis, this study delves into varying levels of Energy Balance Transition (EBT) penetration rates, thereby influencing the intricate tradeoff between curbing emissions and managing system costs.

articleTitle: Exploring User Experience in Mobile Applications: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Mobile applications have been used to facilitate everything in life. User experience is an important aspect in ensuring the convenience of a mobile application by providing experience and satisfaction to users when using an application. Evaluation of user experience is needed to find out the problems experienced by users. Applications evaluated must be carried out using the appropriate method according to what is required by the application. In this study, the analysis and identification of the methods, attributes, and fields of application used in evaluating the user experience of mobile applications were carried out using the systematic literature review method which succeeded in obtaining 109 scientific articles consisting of 58 journals and 51 scientific articles. proceedings from 2018-2023. The results of this study stated that the methods used to evaluate user experience on mobile applications totaled 30 methods, there were 3 methods most often used, namely the System Usability Scale (SUS) method, User Experience Questionnare (UEQ) and Heuristic Evaluation. There are 83 attributes used to test or evaluate user experience in mobile applications, there is 1 attribute that is most often used, namely the attribute efficiency. There are 12 fields of mobile application evaluation of user experience, there is 1 field that is most often evaluated, namely the Health sector.

articleTitle: Digital Ringgit: A New Digital Currency with Traditional Attributes
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The development of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) is underway around the world. They are essential for modernizing the national financial network. While most countries are calling for proof of concept for CBDCs, central banks have taken various approaches to designing CBDCs and are progressing their research and development efforts. Independence. Without CBDCs, private digital currencies will increasingly be dominated by non-financial companies. The appeal and instant recognition of paper money has been established for over 100 years. It is designed to have the appearance of a sovereign currency. Even if there is a serial number written on it, the carrier is still considered the owner without any conditions. Launching a CBDC poses some major challenges. The first technical challenge was to provide an offline device for trading digital currencies. The second technical challenge is called the double spending problem. The third technical challenge is measuring and controlling the velocity of money flow in digital transactions. This project will propose and develop a digital ringgit in light of these challenges. A digital Malaysian ringgit (DRM) note can be uniquely assigned to multiple session numbers. Here there is a need for a blockchain on the digital ringgit. Digital currency initiatives will bring significant benefits to developing economies; hence the cashless system will be useful in the fight against corruption and money laundering. Eventually, the digital ringgit will provide a control mechanism to a central bank, such as Bank Negara Malaysia, on its monetary velocity and growth of electronic money in a cashless society. A digital ringgit has an enormous potential to spur a financial cycle in Malaysia.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Systematic Overview Decentralization Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the face of the Covid-19 pandemic, technological innovations continue to emerge and play an important role in creating a platform to manage the Pandemic. Blockchain technology is a distributed technology as an innovative tool today developed using a peer-to-peer network to distribute data to all participants for storage. This study aims to examine the issue of renewing the Blockchain Technology research platform applied in the health sector, namely the Covid-19 pandemic. The method used is reporting the selected items for the Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Guidelines. In the Google Scientist and Microsoft databases, we found a significant index of peer-reviewed research articles published in December 2021 investigating the application of Blockchain technology. The drawbacks of this research are Blockchain integration with existing HIS, namely: client obstruction, high computational power requests, and execution costs. This research is expected to evaluate the shortcomings of previous research for innovation in future research.

articleTitle: Evaluating Usability: Heuristic Analysis of JKN (Indonesia National Health Insurance) Mobile App User Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Mobile JKN is a BPJS Kesehatan application designed to facilitate health workers in Indonesia providing optimal services and meet the health needs of the community effectively. However, the user interface of the application has been identified with several shortcomings, resulting in a lack of user-friendliness, leading to problems and inaccuracies in the information provided. The study involved 85 respondents who completed questionnaires and three evaluators who assessed the user interface against ten Heuristic criteria, identifying 22 design problems in the application. To address these issues, the researchers developed a prototype with additional features, meeting ten heuristic criteria. The System Usability Scale (SUS) was used to evaluate the initial design, resulting in a score of 60 (grade scale D). After implementing design improvements and retesting, the score increased to 77 (grade scale C), indicating that the design enhancements were well-received by users and successful in enhancing user acceptance and satisfaction. The findings of this study highlight the importance of addressing user interface shortcomings in mobile health applications like Mobile JKN to enhance user experiences and ensure accurate information dissemination, ultimately improving the effectiveness and efficiency of health services provided by BPJS Kesehatan. The successful implementation of the prototype serves as a promising step towards a more user-friendly and impactful application that caters to the health needs of the community. Future research can further explore additional usability enhancements and evaluate the application's performance with a broader user base to solidify its effectiveness and benefits.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Public Health Centers Performance through Sentiment Analysis using LSTM in Bali Province, Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In Indonesia, the transformation of healthcare services is a pressing concern, with the government’s commitment evidenced through initiatives like the “One Data for Indonesian Healthcare” program led by the Ministry of Health. This national effort encompasses six pivotal pillars, including the digitization of healthcare technology. Amidst these developments, Public Health Centers (PHCs) play a central role in the healthcare transformation. Ensuring patient satisfaction is paramount, given their role as primary community healthcare providers and the need to meet standardized service requirements. This study explores the use of sentiment analysis, particularly the Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) architecture, to assess patient satisfaction levels at PHCs. Our LSTM sentiment classification model achieved an accuracy of 74.5% on the test data. These classification results provide valuable insights by patients regarding PHC healthcare services, enabling a deeper analysis of the factors influencing PHC performance. Moreover, the incorporation of Google review sentiments into the healthcare framework augments the parameters for PHC performance evaluation, ultimately improving healthcare services in the country. This research not only contributes a foundational understanding but also sets a benchmark for the potential integration of deep learning techniques within the development of Indonesia’s national digital healthcare system. By embracing innovative technologies like LSTM and harnessing the unfiltered nature of Google Reviews, healthcare stakeholders can gain a comprehensive understanding of patient satisfaction, leading to more informed decisions and policies that enhance the healthcare experience for all Indonesians. This study thus represents a significant step forward in the ongoing healthcare transformation journey in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Strategic Analysis of Green Marketing and Brand Image Towards Purchase Decision Consumer Coffee Shop During Pandemic Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Changes in people’s lifestyles are largely determined by the products they buy, especially for their daily consumption needs. The higher level of community needs, making it a challenge for companies how can they make a new innovation. In order that with the increasing daily consumption needs of the people, it does not interfere with the nature sustainability. During Pandemic Covid-19 in indonesia make Consumer of Coffee Shop using online delivery to purchase any Coffee Shop menu, and it impact of the plastic used to package the meals and drinks. With the brand image of Coffee Shop company which is it have a good perspective from people in Indonesia and the existence of green marketing, especially the packaging of material that Coffee Shop currently have for package meals and drinks is using recycle material instead of using plastic to maintain natural sustainability. This research aims to determine the relationship between Brand Image and Green Marketing on the purchasing decisions of Coffee Shop Consumer, how brand image and green marketing make consumer purchase decision of product in coffee shop by using food delivery platform during pandemic Covid-19 in indonesia. The population used in this study is social media followers on official social media Coffee Shop Indonesia account. The sampling technique used is Simple Random Sampling, which is based on the number of samples obtained 400 respondents. The data analysis technique is multiple linear regression method. The test results show that Brand Image and Green Marketing variables have a significant and positive influence on purchasing decisions and From the results of the t test and f test, it shows that brand image and green marketing partially and simultaneously affect the purchase decision of Coffee Shop consumers. It shows that the relationship between Brand Image and Green Marketing have an impact on increasing consumer purchasing decision.

articleTitle: Impacts of IT Governance Mechanisms on Organizational Agility
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Many attempts to operate online businesses have recently failed to survive the competitive environments. They typically expand quickly by providing a wide range of goods and services. However, there are still holes. It is evident that no literature has addressed the effects of IT-enabled dynamic capabilities and IT-strategic alignment on the agility of online businesses. The goal of the study was to verify and determine the degree to which IT governance has a favorable impact on organizational agility. Using a follow-up description model, the research employed a survey method with an explanatory design. 258 individuals were able to successfully send the researchers their surveys. For over five years, they have operated various web enterprises in Indonesia’s West Kalimantan province. To process all of the data that were gathered and examined using the SEM-PLS approach, Likert scales were employed. On the other hand, bootstrapping was used to disperse the data in a typical way. Additional input was gathered. The findings show that IT governance is a key component and that dynamic capabilities afforded by IT have a variable impact on increasing organizational agility, particularly when it comes to online commerce.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Website Quality: Usability, Information, Service Interaction & Visual Quality on Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The largest number of people live in Indonesia. Consequently, there is a sizable market in Indonesia. Internet technology is another factor that might expand business opportunities. E-commerce has flourished in recent years due to the exponential growth of the internet in Indonesia. E-commerce is growing in popularity as the number of people who have access to the internet grows. Bandung is one of these places; it has the second-highest number of online shoppers among Indonesian cities. Improving the online shopping experience is one strategy for attracting more customers. One of the foundations of the e-commerce business model is the website, the quality of which may be upgraded to boost customer happiness. The purpose of this research is to characterize and share information regarding the impact of e-commerce site quality on customer happiness. A total of 385 participants were surveyed using a quantitative questionnaire for this study. WebQual 4.0 is used to assess the quality of a website. This, plus the inclusion of a new factor—the visual quality as measured by VISAWI—in the evaluation of website quality. SEM PLS is used as the method of analysis. Based on the research that has been done, data shows that the website quality and visual appearance of Zalora’s e-commerce has a positive and significant influence on visitor satisfaction.

articleTitle: Technology Adaptation for ShopeeFood’s Digital Transformation Empowers Driver Partners in Bogor City
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Technological developments bring changes in the food ordering sector. Delivery orders with the ordering application are an option. However, workers come from various backgrounds who may not be familiar with technology. Therefore, to make a shift towards a culture in society, it is necessary to socialize the innovations that will be offered. In the theory of innovation diffusion, new technology can only be accepted if it fits the characteristics of society. This research method uses a qualitative approach with the case study method. Data collection techniques using participatory observation, interviews, and literature studies. The results of the study show that what was carried out by the shopeefood marketing party in the form of welfare and convenience in carrying out order activities such as partner welfare, service quality, marketing strategy and shopeefood innovation have been successfully communicated to partners and also the community in Bogor City through various elements of innovation diffusion such as: communication channel, social system, timeframe, innovation and media communication. This research also reveals some of the challenges faced by driver-partners in adopting ShopeeFood technology. These challenges include limited access to technological tools and the training needed to optimize the use of applications. In addition, competition with other driver-partners is also a factor affecting the performance and business results of driver-partners in the city of Bogor.

articleTitle: Mobile Academic Information Systems for Students: Measuring End-User Computing Satisfaction (EUCS)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Mobile Academic Information System (MAIS) for Students is a mobile-oriented platform designed to facilitate various educational tasks, including course planning, schedule viewing, and access to scholarship offerings. Based on initial investigations by scholars, several issues persist with the existing system, including inaccuracies in grade input and the absence of updated scholarly material. This study aims to assess the level of satisfaction among end users of the MAIS by utilizing the End-User Computing Satisfaction (EUCS) model. The EUCS model is a commonly employed framework for assessing the satisfaction levels of end users concerning information technologies. The extended EUCS model, encompasses several criteria, including content, accuracy, format, ease of use, timeliness, and system speed. The research employed a quantitative method through the administration of questionnaires. The participants in this study consisted of students from UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta who have utilized a certain application. A total of 117 participants were chosen as the sample for this investigation. The researchers employed purposive and incidental sampling strategies to conduct the sampling process. The data analysis methodology employed in this study utilized the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) approach, utilizing SmartPLS version 3.2.9 software. The findings indicate that the EUCS factors collectively significantly impact user satisfaction, accounting for 71% of the variance. The determinants impacting user satisfaction encompass the aspects of ease of use, timelines, and system speed. According to the study's findings, it is recommended that developers of MAIS prioritize their focus on the aspects that impact user satisfaction. Specifically, the variables not supported by this study, including content, accuracy, and format, should be considered carefully.

articleTitle: Cross-Industry Standard Process For Data Mining (CRISP-DM) For Discovering Association Rules in Graduate Tracer Study Data of Islamic Higher Education Institution
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Career Development Center (CDC) at UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta faces challenges when designing development programs for its diverse graduate groups, including those employed, pursuing further studies, or engaged in entrepreneurship. The complexity of tracer study data hampers the identification of prevailing association patterns. This study aims to uncover these patterns within UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta’s tracer study data, aiding the CDC in enhancing career services and target mapping for diverse graduates. The research follows the CRISP-DM (Cross-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining) methodology, using the FP-Growth algorithm. Tracer study data from 2021 UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta graduates (1355 records) is reduced to 925 records for analysis using RapidMiner and Microsoft Excel. The findings reveal association patterns for graduates categorized by employment status, educational pursuits, entrepreneurship endeavors, and advanced graduates not employed. This research offers a structured approach to navigate tracer study data complexities and proposes an action plan for enhancing UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta Career Center services based on these patterns, providing a systematic guide to address the tracer study data complexity.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Outbreak Virus Classification: Utilizing Bidirectional GRU on DNA Sequence of SARS-CoV-2, Zika, Ebola, and MERS
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Over the past decades, at least 4 types of virus have caused global outbreaks and pandemics: SARS-CoV-2, Zika, Ebola, and MERS. In order to reduce losses, researcher manage to classify the virus. DNA sequence plays an essential role in defining the specific virus, and the sequence itself must be accurate. Processing virus data on a large scale also requires the integration of computer science to help speed up the analysis and processing of DNA sequence data. In this instance where the model must comprehend the context of each sequence, BiGRUs are used because it has better data understanding ability in order to generate correct predictions. Using Bi-GRU and N-Mers Frequency, outbreak virus classification based on DNA Sequence has been made. The model successfully classifying between outbreak virus and also resulting good performance. It has 100% of Accuracy, 100% of F1-Score, 100% of Recall, and 100% of Precision on all data (training, validation, and testing data). This model later will be useful in determining the most suitable treatments for a detected virus-caused disease while also providing new understanding for bioinformatics research.

articleTitle: Student Perceptions of User Satisfaction and User Loyalty of Website Based E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This paper discusses the importance of information technology development in facilitating human life through website-based e-learning. E-learning accelerates the dissemination of knowledge, particularly during the Covid-19 pandemic when online learning surged. However, users encounter challenges, such as unclear task instructions and platform errors. This research aims to enhance the quality of e-learning services by analyzing students’ perceptions of user satisfaction and loyalty on three major e-learning platforms in Indonesia. The study employs the EUCS model augmented with System Quality dimensions. Respondents are middle and high school students in DKI Jakarta who have used one of the e-learning platforms. The results from 209 respondents indicate high user satisfaction, scoring 85.93, and a high level of user loyalty, scoring 84.69. Factors such as Content, Format, Ease of use, Timeliness, Instructor quality, and Course Materials show a positive relationship with user satisfaction, with Course Materials being the most influential. However, hypotheses regarding Accuracy, Administrative and support service quality, and Security and privacy did not prove to have a significant impact. This research is expected to expand the understanding of factors influencing user satisfaction and loyalty in website-based e-learning and provide guidance for improving the quality of e-learning to enhance student satisfaction and loyalty.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Disaster Sentiment Analysis of Unbalanced Twitter Data: The Case of Indonesia Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The unbalanced dataset dramatically impacted the effectiveness of classification techniques, often leading to classifiers that were biased towards the majority class. Researchers had proposed deep learning along with random undersampling and oversampling to address this issue. This study conducted a comparative analysis between undersampling and oversampling methods for handling imbalanced class data. In addition, a deep learning approach was employed, specifically utilizing bidirectional LSTM and attention mechanisms. The method was assessed using a confusion matrix. The findings of this study demonstrated that oversampling surpassed undersampling, achieving an impressive F1 score of 79.87%.

articleTitle: A Novel Stair-Climbing Robot Controlled Using the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This researcher's goal is to create and deploy a remote control system by utilizing an affordable and easy-to-use Internet of Things (IoT) platform. The design of the circuit described in this article consists of an Arduino Mega 2560, an ESP8266 microcontroller, and a gyroscope sensor as its constituent components. The utilization of the gyroscope sensor could potentially facilitate the determination of the robot's orientation, thereby enabling the preservation of its equilibrium during the traversal of the stairwell. The locomotion system of the robot potentially incorporates a pair of direct current motors to drive its wheels, thereby facilitating its ability to ascend staircases. The stair-climbing robot underwent comprehensive testing to evaluate its performance, with a specific focus on aligning operational values with anticipated values. During the robot's ascent of stairs, the study revealed an average inclination angle of 90.5671 degrees, with a minimal deviation of 0.6301 degrees. As the robot descended the stairs, the average total inclination measured at 89.6883 degrees, accompanied by a percentage error of 0.3463 degrees, all while participants walked on a determined level surface. Additionally, while navigating flat terrain, the average inclination degree was 91.60173 degrees, with a percentage error of 1.7797 degrees. Notably, during stair climbing, the mean inclination angle was 138.1558 degrees, showing a mean variation of 1.3172 degrees. Each stair-climbing rotation came with its associated error value, though the average gyroscope readings consistently fell within an acceptable range of parameters, indicating satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Reading Behavior: A Business Model Canvas Approach for Marketing E-Books Library
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This digital era has changed people’s behaviour, including people’s behaviour in reading. Seeing changes in people’s behaviour in tasks that prefer everything digital, reading sources need to be marketed in digital form, such as e-books and e-journals. These e-books and e-journals are available at E-Book, Raharja University’s digital library. This study aims to provide a Business Model Canvas (BMC) as a marketing business strategy that can make it easier for the public to find books and journals in universities. This research was also conducted using the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method. The novelty in this research is also the use of the Business Model Canvas (BMC), which incorporates elements as a reference in marketing e-books and e-journals in e-books. The results show that the Value Proposition offered by e-books is to provide convenience, a more affordable price, and a more trusted platform for the public to obtain reading resources. With the Value Proposition of the Business Model Canvas (BMC), this research will provide benefits in the future, make it easier for people to read and can indirectly increase the number of people’s reading interest in Indonesia.

articleTitle: User Satisfaction Analysis of Telecommunication Customer Service Mobile Applications Using the End User Computing Satisfaction (EUCS) Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The increasing number of telecommunications services users and the rapid development of technology have an impact to cellular telecommunications service providers in Indonesia. They must compete to provide the best service to their users. One way to compete is by providing digital assistant applications which have the main function such as checking quotas and purchasing internet quota. However, this application still has several weaknesses, so that user satisfaction is not optimal and has an impact on not achieving application purpose. Nowadays, a study about user satisfaction has been done by researchers because user satisfaction has an impact on the business. No exception including the telecommunication service provider business. This study aims to determine the level of user satisfaction and the factors that influence user satisfaction of mobile telecommunication services application. The research used quantitative methods and End User Computing Satisfaction (EUCS) model with the addition of two variables, namely system speed and system reliability. Data analysis used the PLS-SEM approach and the SmartPLS version 3.3.3 application. The results of the research show that 2 of 7 hypotheses tested were rejected, namely accuracy and ease of use. The system speed and system reliability that was added to the EUCS model have a positive impact on user satisfaction. So, these variables can be used in EUCS model to analysis user satisfaction on another context. This research also provides an overview of application user satisfaction and can provide consideration for application developers to planning application development so that it can be even better.

articleTitle: Developing Instruments for Digital Talent Competence Using Partial Least Square-Based Models
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Research on measuring digital talent competencies using explainable artificial intelligence is lacking in depth. The study aimed to address this gap by developing a reliable and valid measurement instrument for digital talent. SmartPLS 4.0 was employed for calculations and quality assessment. The measurement model was assessed from both reflective and formative perspectives, using Google Forms to gather responses from 600 participants. The 60 questionnaire items exhibited high validity and reliability, as evidenced by loading factors and composite reliability exceeding 0.70. Direct effects were found in various competencies: adaptability and flexibility had a 0.744 effect on learning dexterity, achievement orientation showed a 0.782 effect on innovative creation skills, customer service orientation had a 0.810 effect on digital networking, and digital communication skills exhibited a 0.824 effect on continual improvement. The measurement model met various criteria for reliability and validity, including loading factors, composite reliability, average variance extracted, cross loadings, Fornell Lacker Criterion, and Heterotrait Monotrait Ratio. These findings supported the acceptance of the measurement model’s quality and validity. SmartPLS analysis yielded an average communality of 0.624 and an average R Square of 0.592, resulting in a GoF index of 0.608. This GoF index, according to Wetzel et al. (2018), falls in the high fit category, indicating the model’s appropriateness for measuring digital talent competencies. In summary, the study successfully developed a robust measurement model for digital talent competencies using explainable artificial intelligence and demonstrated its high fit and reliability for assessing digital talent in various contexts.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on News Headlines of Nation’s Capital Relocation Using CNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The relocation of the nation's capital is an important decision. In Indonesia, this is seen as an urgency that aims to elevate economic growth, improve economic equality outside capital city (Java Island). The plan of moving the country’s capital has announced by various online news media and resulted many pros and cons. This research is a sentiment analysis of news headlines on the topic of moving new country’s capital of Indonesia on online news detik.com using CNN and SVM models. This research aims to know the results of sentiment and which model that have the best performance. The research flow uses SEMMA method. The 3.5K news headline dataset had 48% neutral sentiment, 34.7% positive sentiment, and 17.3% negative sentiment, which were automatically labeled by Vader. The labeled dataset from each class was then back-translated and adjusted to achieve a balanced amount of data. The dataset is fed into CNN and SVM models with Stratified K-Fold Cross Validation (k=10). Model evalution shows SVM model has better performance with 90.65% accuracy, compared to CNN with 84,92%. The sentiment result is interpreted in general and generate suggestion that the Indonesian government able to focus on the development of IKN infrastructure first to provide important signals for investors as seeing the government's seriousness in working on huge projects, but they still have to look after other priority programs so that overall government plans able to run on target.

articleTitle: Quantifying the Effects of Renewable Energy Advancement: A Statistical Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
