abstract: This research aims to analyze the diverse impacts of renewable energy progress using a statistical analysis method. The study investigates correlations between variables, including current account balance, interest rates, money flows, electricity, industry application, and international energy trade balance. Employing multiple regression and principal component analysis (PCA), the research is structured in two phases. Initially, multiple regression is utilized to examine the influence of monetary policy on renewable energy growth, employing nine macroeconomic variables and four energy indicators from the World Bank database (2017). Each economic indicator is subjected to regression analysis against energy variables. Subsequently, principal component analysis is performed on the 13 variables, revealing a strong correlation between renewable energy share in government spending and growth (GSG). Moreover, a notable correlation is observed between government spending, foreign exchange reserves, and industrial application, contributing to significant cost savings. This research highlights limitations such as limited access to renewable energy sources and data gaps, which could be addressed through enhanced datasets from the World Bank and the International Renewable Energy Agency.

articleTitle: Concept, Technology, Barriers To Smart Village: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Smart villages that utilize digital technology are a solution to assist rural community services in meeting their needs, especially for developing countries. However, financial problems, namely the high cost of infrastructure, the size of the informal economy and governance are challenges in limiting the government’s aspirations regarding the smart village concept. The presentation of this article examines the state of smart village development in developing countries, which includes conceptual understanding, motivations, drivers and barriers to smart villages. The purpose of this study is to find answers to research questions by reviewing several selected study articles. The method used was to search for selected studies and there were 60 selected studies identified from a search of five literature databases which initially contained 3394 articles. The results of the data were analyzed using synthetic analysis and thematic analysis. The results of this study found data related to Concept, Technology, Barriers To Smart Village which came from several articles by answering questions from the research, namely RQ1: How many articles from the 10 most populous countries discussed Smart Village, RQ2: What are the basic dimensions of Smart Village, RQ3: What new technologies are discussed in Smart Village digitization, RQ4: What are the Challenges in Smart Village. The results of this SLR can also later be used as a reference for further researchers to find out the background of research related to smart villages. The conclusion obtained in this research is the end of the explanation of this article concludes that there are still many shortcomings in this research and it is hoped that in the future many studies will be able to explore other aspects such as regulations and others that are not discussed in the article so that it is expected to be a reference for further researchers to examine information related to smart villages. in order to find an ideal and up-to-date concept according to the times.

articleTitle: Business Sub-Process Analysis and Redesign of Counceling Week (Pekan Konseling) at Career Center Services using Business Process Improvement (BPI)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the digital age, institutions face numerous challenges in conducting their business processes due to rapid technological advancements and increasing complexity. To ensure the quality of these processes, institutions can implement business process management, which encompasses all stages of the process life cycle. However, limitations still exist in terms of complexity, maintenance, and automation. Business process management aims to manage, support, and analyze operations from a high-level managerial perspective. This study examines the business process analysis of Universitas Islam Negeri Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta Career Center’s sub-processes, specifically career guidance and counseling services (Pekan Konseling), using the Business Process Improvement method. The analysis provides recommendations for modeling current (As-Is) and future (ToBe) business processes and redesign current processes, with a focus on the need for automation using a system or platform for Counseling Week activities.

articleTitle: Development Of A Question Answering Model Using The Indobert Algorithm To Evaluate Website Content In Indonesian Language
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Technology is currently developing increasingly sophisticated and making the use of digital technology increasingly easier for humans. One example of technological development is the development of natural language processing (NLP) technology to support better information search and extraction functions. This research aims to implement the Natural language processing (NLP) method and the BERT algorithm in the question-answering system to help analyze the relationship between website content and search engine search results. This research uses a literature study method, namely looking for references in the form of books, journals, research report articles, and sites on the internet. Apart from that, in data collection, a dataset search was also carried out regarding the question-answering model needed to create a question-answering system using the IndoBERT algorithm for evaluating website content in Indonesian. Then, the results of this research can be categorized as quite good with an Exact Match (EM) of 60.21% and an F1 Score of 71.36%. This indicates the model’s ability to provide appropriate and relevant answers in a large number of cases. This research was also successful in extracting content from web pages and evaluating it using BERT Score.

articleTitle: Analysis Adoption of Information Technology Using the UTAUT Method on Poultry Farmers in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The effects of information technology advancements started to be seen in livestock. Broiler chickens account for 67% of the meat produced by poultry farming, local/free-range chickens account for 23% and the remaining flesh comes from various varieties of poultry. Bali’s poultry farmers’ business management becomes unproductive and inefficient since not all of them employ information technology to manage their business procedures. The aim of this research was to ascertain how interested and likely Bali’s poultry farmers were to use the Agree PT XYZ program as a form of information technology. The Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) paradigm served as the foundation for the research approach in this study. In order to gather study data, questionnaires were given out to respondents in five Bali districts. The partial least squares structural equation model is employed for data management. According to the study’s findings, use behavior is directly, favorably, and significantly influenced by social influence and performance expectations. Useful and positive conduct is directly influenced by behavior purpose. This research can provide recommendations for software developers that the factors that influence behavior intention are performance expectancy and social influence. Farmers are interested in using the agree application due to expectations of performance and the influence of the social environment. Supporting facilities are not too concerned by breeders because the condition of internet facilities is not a problem at their location and breeders think that technological changes are inevitable in the era of change and must be applied to the breeder’s business process.

articleTitle: Predicting Loneliness using SVM, Logistic Regression and Decision Tree in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This research objective is to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to detect Loneliness in the community using the demographics dataset. It uses Rajabhat Dataset and Machine Learning algorithms (SVM, Logistic Regression, and Decision Tree) to classify their loneliness levels in percentage. For the data collection, it gathers data from ten sub-districts from both Pathum Thani and Sakaew province with 3,349 households (11,214 population samples) for learning and testing a model. Regression is the best model’s accuracy to analyse loneliness from the entire dataset. For demographic examples, Females, males, and ages have explained 78.47% of the variance from Loneliness. The effect differed significantly from zero, $F =20424.65, p = \lt.001,R^{2}= 0.78.$ Finally, the demographic can be used to detect loneliness from the participant as the early classification services for the local community as the loneliness analysis approach. The results are presented at the end of this research. However, there is no single way to detect loneliness, which varies depending on the individual and situation.

articleTitle: Analyzing Radicalism-Related Conversation Patterns on Twitter: A Comparative Study of Association Rules with Apriori and FP-Growth Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Currently, there is a rapid boom in technological development, with social media being recognized as a prominent platform for swift information dissemination. Within this context, radicalism remains a topic of discussion on social media, particularly on platforms like Twitter. In light of this, there is a need to comprehend the conversation patterns concerning radicalism. To achieve this, an analysis of public conversation patterns on social media was carried out, focusing on Twitter data with the keyword “radicalism.” Association rules were utilized to identify noteworthy correlations within extensive data sets, comparing results obtained through the Apriori and FP-Growth algorithms. A total of 3343 tweet data entries were employed for this analysis. Applying a minimum support of 0.04 and a minimum confidence of 0.4, the Apriori algorithm produced 4 association rules, whereas the FP-Growth algorithm generated 64 association rules. The findings indicate that the FP-Growth algorithm was more successful in identifying a comprehensive set of patterns in comparison to the Apriori algorithm.

articleTitle: The Impact of Electronic Word of Mouth on Willingness to Promote the Online Travel Services
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The urgency of this research is to prove whether online sales have succeeded in attracting customers and increasing sales so that airlines can create programs to attract customer purchases to compete with other companies in the aviation industry. In order to properly analyze all of the variables in this research, a sample size of at least 107 is required, as shown by the G-Power estimate. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) was used for this investigation. E-wom and demand-related pricing are two predictors of online travel fair customer satisfaction. These two areas contribute to online travel fair client happiness. Implementing the two predictors increases service promotion willingness. The management of the online travel fair is also required to preserve client happiness by listening to customer feedback so they can increase consumer desire to market the service. Management should give a timely response and outstanding service to boost customer satisfaction and referrals.

articleTitle: Data Mining to Predict the Ability of Prospective Customer Credit Payments
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In this expansion of credit activities, of course, the financial side expects that the money lent by the debtor and the interest will be repaid on time. Therefore, in the expansion of credit, banks and other institutions always strive to carry out comprehensive credit supervision and credit collectability in securities or other investments for determine credit quality by anticipating credit risk early. However, in practice there are still problems, where the provision of credit facilities to customers who need to experience credit problems that are lent cannot be repaid by the customer to the financial party as agreed. This is the condition of the debtor himself who has no willingness to pay the credit and credit that has been received. Also, the use of wrong credit is because its use is not in accordance with the original request or is directly related to weak procedures, insufficient credit analysis and ineffective supervision from the creditor. The purpose of this study is to find patterns of credit ability of prospective customers to make it easier for financial institutions to accurately predict the ability of credit payments of prospective customers based on the characteristics of the dataset, so that the contribution of this research can be applied to several other financial institutions by utilizing the field of data mining as a system that is able to predict patterns and find ways to analyze customer needs, determine the right product marketing targets for customers using the naive Bayes algorithm with the help of the WEKA tool. The results of this study show an accuracy rate of 78.56% with a precision of 93.46% and a recall of 72.78% to choose the credit quality of prospective customers who are able to pay loans smoothly and on time according to the agreement time.

articleTitle: Usability Evaluation on Website Using the Cognitive Walkthrough Method
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Usability testing conducted on the PT Beli Jelantah Trafiguras website was carried out with the aim of identifying and analyzing the level of usability of the website, finding various new problems related to usability that are felt directly by website users, as well as providing recommendations for improvements in the form of analysis that can improve design and functionality on linked websites. The method used in this research is the Cognitive Walkthrough method with 10 (ten) respondents. The results of this study indicate that the related website still has several interface problems, such as unclear colors and font sizes, too many and ambiguous logos, incomplete registration instructions, and so on. The linked website also has a medium usability level with an effectiveness level of 67.5% and an efficiency level of 57.9%.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Satisfaction with iLearning Education: An Application of the TAM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study aims to analyze student satisfaction in using iLearning Education, a website facilitating distance learning programs at Raharja University. The sampling method used is simple random sampling. This study focuses on students’ intentions to use iLearning Education. We applied the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and used a structural equation modelling approach with SmartPLS 4.0 software to investigate the student adoption process. The developed model explains students’ intentions in utilizing iLearning Education. The results showed that iLearning Education significantly affects perceived usefulness and student satisfaction. This impacts students’ intentions to utilize iLearning Education as a more straightforward, faster, and efficient learning tool. Thus, this study shows that iLearning Education provides substantial benefits for students in distance learning at Raharja University. The conclusion from this study is that iLearning Education has a positive influence on students’ intentions to use it. In the era of distance learning, the use of iLearning Education can increase student usability and satisfaction and facilitate a more efficient learning process. Therefore, it is recommended that Raharja University continue to develop and improve iLearning Education as a learning platform that can meet student needs and support the distance learning process.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Transition Towards Sustainable Development: Benefits, Constraints, and Policy Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The Renewable Energy (REY) has undergone modifications, laying a strong foundation for the “Renewable Energy Transition” (RET). The majority ownership of the “Renewable Energy Transition” lies with local members or shareholders, empowering it to distribute energy in the transition process. This, in turn, has the potential to unlock separate property and funding for renewable energy sources while providing social benefits. However, it’s important to note that technical solutions must be accompanied by increased public participation, considering aspects like interpretation, manufacturing expertise, spatial planning, and social sciences to ensure the successful implementation of any energy transformation. We recognize that investments and governance principles that account for the complementarity of renewable energy, spatial potential, demographics, potential resistance from incumbents, and the inclusion of traditionally marginalized communities are crucial for implementing REY and achieving a just energy transition in all Member States. This study employs a literature review to highlight the benefits and conducts a comparative analysis, considering recent literature, to address the constraints associated with the broad development of the Renewable Energy Transition. It also offers policy guidance for effective implementation, drawing examples from instances of delayed transition processes.

articleTitle: Number of Road Accidents Predicting Using Deep Learning-Based LSTM Development Models
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Road accidents cause chaos and state financial losses every year. Road accidents cannot be stopped but can be controlled with predictions. The existing road accident prediction model accuracy for the medium and long term still has many discrepancies, and it is rarely done. A comparison of the deep learning algorithms of the LSTM, Bi-LSTM, ConvLSTM, and Att-LSTM models with hidden layer variations is used to select the suitable model to make predictions. Use data from the road accident dataset in Thailand in 2011-2022, which can be accessed freely on Kaggle. The results show that the BiLSTM model with 4 hidden layers can predict the number of road accidents in the medium and long term with the highest accuracy. MSLE is used to measure the accuracy of the model with variations without hidden layers, 2 hidden layers, and 4 hidden layers to find the best model for predicting the number of road accidents for the medium and long term.

articleTitle: Steganography of Least Significant Bit Algorithm and Combination of Cryptography Vigenere Cipher with Rivest Code 4 for Email Message Security
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The combination technique of cryptographic and steganographic algorithms is carried out to strengthen protection in securing data which is currently rife with hacking. The combination of the Vigenere Cipher with various algorithms is quite calculated. This study aims to determine the process of implementing the Least Significant Bit and the Vigenere Cipher combination with Rivest Code 4 in securing data messages and their performance. The research method will use the Least Significant Bit algorithm, Vigenere Cipher, and Rivest Code 4 with the waterfall development method. The Base64 algorithm will be used to convert files into text form. The results of the research will be in the form of an image steganographic cover sent via email. The results reveal that the implementation of the Least Significant Bit and the Vigenere Cipher Combination with Rivest Code 4 in securing text email messages was 100% successful after testing 20 random samples with the combination sequence starting with the Vigenere Cipher algorithm sequence then going to Rivest Code 4 then hidden with the Least Significant Bit in the encryption process while the decryption process is done in reverse order. Meanwhile, email messages in the form of files need to be converted first with the Base 64 technique to get a byte array of text so that they can be implemented in applications. Differences in the type and size of the image, the number of characters in the message content, and the number of characters in the key affect the duration of the encryption and decryption process but do not affect the pixel dimensions of the image. Meanwhile, the number of characters in the contents of the message will affect the size of the image data so that the more characters in the contents, the larger the size of the image.

articleTitle: Exploring User Behavior of mHealth Application: A Study of Determinants of Continuance Usage Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: This study aims to assess and analyze the antecedents of continuance usage intention on health application users by combining the modified technology continuance theory (TCT) with the theory of planned behavior (TPB) and the privacy-trust-behavioral intention (PTB) model. Modified TCT consists of confirmation, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, satisfaction, attitude, and continuance usage intention. TPB consists of attitude, perceived behavioral control, subjective norm, and continuance usage intention as behavioral intention. PTB consists of perceived privacy and security risk, trust, and continuance usage intention as behavioral intentions. The method used in this study is non-probability sampling, which is purposive sampling through a questionnaire. The targeted population was mobile health application users, with 118 samples. Statistical results were analyzed with PLS-SEM in SmartPLS 4.0.9.1. The result of the study showed positive and significant effects in the modified TCT except for perceived ease of use-perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use-attitude, and satisfaction-continuance usage intention. The results also showed positive and significant effects on TPB and PTB variables. Furthermore, the study revealed that attitude strongly affected continuance usage intention (0.357). Research outcomes indicated an essential contribution toward user post-adoptive behavior on mobile health applications. The user’s attitude toward health applications is a relatively stable variable that can be influenced and shaped by experiences over time, leading to a more positive or negative outlook depending on the nature of those experiences. This study provides valuable insight for mHealth application developers and researchers in human behavior and health technology.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Engagement in Computational Physics through Project-Based Learning: An Exploration of VBA Physics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the realm of computational physics education, enhancing student engagement remains a pivotal challenge. This research delved into the potential of Project-Based Learning (PBL), with a particular emphasis on the VBA Physics Simulation, to invigorate students’ learning engagement. By surveying undergraduate students’ perceptions in computational physics course, we observed a predominant positive response towards the PBL model. The findings underscore that students not only appreciate the structured learning experience PBL offers but also value the guidance from lecturers in this approach. Through the lens of PBL, students reported a marked improvement in various skills, including the 4C skills (Critical thinking, Communication, Collaboration, Creativity), problem-solving, and higher-order thinking skills. This study advocates for the broader integration of PBL in computational physics course, especially using tools like VBA Physics Simulation, as a means to deepen understanding and amplify student engagement. We also recommend future quantitative research to further solidify these findings.

articleTitle: Impact of Earning Zakat Based on Blockchain Technology on Community Welfare
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Banten Province, which borders the capital city of the Republic of Indonesia, suffers from poor sanitation. Furthermore, variables like as education level and poverty rates contribute to the community’s poor health conditions, which frequently leads to them turning to high-interest loans supplied by moneylenders. Advocates of productive zakat, who give capital support to citizens, freeing them from the clutches of excessive loan rates, have proposed a solution to this dilemma. This study intends to provide information that can help zakat administrators (such as BAZ and LAZ) develop priority initiatives aimed at improving healthy lives and self-sufficiency patterns. When directed as assistance for the community’s health-promoting activities, productive zakat has the potential to improve well-being.This study intends to provide an examination of how productive zakat promotes healthy lives and, as a result, well-being. It also investigates the influence of productive zakat on encouraging self-reliance patterns and the resulting implications on the welfare of people in need, using blockchain technology. It takes a mixed-methodologies approach, combining quantitative and qualitative methods within a sequential explanatory frame-work.The quantitative data analysis employs SEMPLS via the smartPLS program, and the qualitative data analysis employs phenomenological analysis using the ATLAS.ti software. In terms of building self-sufficiency, the provision of skills and capital through productive zakat has an impact on autonomous patterns. However, it is vital to emphasize that productive zakat has no direct influence on the design of self-reliance, and self-reliance patterns have no substantial impact on the mustahik’s welfare.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breeding Control: The IoT-Driven Automated System for Budgie Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In Thailand’s Pak Phanang Nok Hong Yok Farm, where budgies are raised, it emphasizes the value of proper care and surroundings. The primary problem this research addresses is the need for efficient and automated management of budgie farms, encompassing aspects such as feeding, watering, and temperature control and overcoming language barriers for Thailand’s budgie farmers. An innovative Internet of Things (IoT) solution is suggested, departing from conventional approaches to handle challenges connected to manual care and environmental management for farmers. This system provides solutions for these challenges while enhancing monitoring and facilitating automated control. Through this IoT-based solution, the research intends to increase productivity, save time, and decrease bird mortality while enabling users to manage their farms remotely. Comprehensive methodologies involving breeding, environmental considerations, and hardware and software design are outlined, resulting in significant advancement in budgie farming practices and showcasing IoT’s potential in agriculture.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model The Successful Use of Information Technology in Distance Learning at State Islamic Universities (PTKIN)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The effects of the Covid-19 pandemic are felt by the whole world and have an impact on various sectors of life, including the education sector. Education in Indonesia is entering a new era, where the entire academic community is required to adapt to Distance Learning (DL) to avoid exposure to the Covid-19 virus. This rapid adjustment has led to many pros and cons among the academic community. This study aims to propose a model and obtain factors that influence the measurement of the success rate of DL based on a sample from UIN Syarif Hidayatullah which are the biggest universities under the Ministry of Religion of the Republic of Indonesia. This study uses variables from the DeLone & McLean model, namely system quality, information quality, Service quality system use, user satisfaction, and organization impact. The results of the study were carried out by observing since February 2020, as well as distributing a questionnaire survey to 139 respondents, getting the results that the successful use of DL technology has succeeded in providing support for system quality and service. Based on the calculation of the results of data analysis, the variable user satisfaction on organizational impact is the highest factor based on the t-test value of 6.643 which has a significant influence on the success of DL at PTKIN. While the service quality variable on system use is the lowest factor based on the t-test value of 1.645 which has no significant effect on the success of DL at PTKIN.

articleTitle: User-Centered User Interface Design for Educational Game: Letter and Number Recognition for Slow Learners
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Children with mental retardation are children who have intellectual mental disorders with intelligence levels far below the average normal child and their social adaptation is hampered. With the limited development of intelligence experienced by slow learner children, education is needed that can train their mindset so that they can develop in such a way. One of them is by using educational games intended for children who have mental retardation. Educational games are the right solution to help improve logic and understanding of learning material in the form of attractive visual technology for slow learnerchildren. With these problems, the authors designed a prototype design of an educational game application for recognizing letters and numbers for slow learnerchildren using the User Centered Design (UCD) method. In evaluating the success of the high-fidelity prototype using the Heuristic Evaluation method. The Heuristic Evaluation questionnaire was distributed to three evaluators and processed using a Likert scale measurement. The results obtained are that the design of the letter and number recognition educational game application for slow learnerchildren meets the usability criteria which is the effectiveness, efficiency, and user satisfaction in using the application as much as 79.13% which is on an attractive scale.

articleTitle: Continuance Use Intention Analysis on Paid Streaming Service Using Expectation-Confirmation Model (ECM)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Netflix was a paid streaming service in Indonesia in January 2016. However, it turns out that Netflix is the only option for using paid streaming services in Indonesia. According to research by Media Partner Asia (MPA), in Indonesia itself, Netflix is still unable to compete with the newcomer streaming service, namely Disney+ Hotstar, and many Internet users in Indonesia are still happy to access illegal streaming sites, so piracy actors continue to appear even though the government has been aggressively close their service. This study aims to analyze continuance use intention or intentions sustainable use of the Netflix paid streaming service in Indonesia and determine what factors influence it based on the proposed model. The main model of this research is the Expectation-Confirmation Model (ECM), which is a user satisfaction model that influences the user's intention to reuse an application by adding the variables habit, enjoyment, subjective norm, and perceived playfulness. The PLS-SEM method, with the help of SmartPLS 4 tools, was used to analyze an online survey of 320 respondents. The results show that habit is the biggest predictor of continuance use intention, followed by subjective norms, perceived usefulness, and finally, perceived playfulness. It is proven that confirmation greatly influences perceived usefulness. The findings of this research provide an opportunity better to understand the long-term viability of Netflix in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Responding to Digital Transformation: The Implication of Transformational Leadership to Predict MSMEs Learning Agility
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Leadership is crucial to organizational agility. However, the question remains how MSMEs managers may combine the four aspects of transformational leadership to boost organizational agility in the digital transformation era. This research examines the link between transformational leadership in predicting the learning agility of MSMEs. A sample of 203 Indonesian MSMEs’ employees investigated the research hypothesis. Fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) method was used to investigates the complex causality of transformational leadership towards MSMEs’ learning agility. FsQCA found five configurations linked to high agility and this study resulted that idealized influence, inspirational motivation and individual consideration will lead the MSMEs to achieve high learning agility. This research gives theoretical and managerial direction to scholars and managers who want to encourage organizational learning agility in the MSME sector by utilizing the four dimensions of transformational leadership. Next, other theoretical contribution, practical implication, and future direction are also discussed.

articleTitle: Thailand Carbon Dioxide Emissions Forecasting using Stacked LSTM-based Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Over the past few decades, Thailand has emerged as a prominent producer of carbon dioxide (CO2), ranking third in emissions after Poland and Taiwan. The emission of CO2 is a significant factor in global warming, which has had substantial adverse effects on both the economy and human life. Accurately predicting CO2 emissions is crucial for evaluating Thailand's existing low-carbon environmental protection policies. However, conventional forecasting models primarily rely on historical data regularities and rarely incorporate new information on development trends. "Stacked Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is used as an algorithm for forecasting and analyzing CO2 emissions in Thailand. The study employs a dataset covering the period from 1987 to 2021. The LSTM model is evaluated against VAR (Vector Autoregression) and ARIMA (Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average) to assess its predictive performance. The LSTM model demonstrates significantly higher accuracy in forecasting CO2 emissions, outperforming other models with lower RMSE (698.94), MAE (609.86), and MAPE (4.54%) values, making it the most suitable choice for this study. The prediction results are deployed and visualized on a website-based application using TensorFlow.js. Furthermore, this research contributes to the advancement and expansion of LSTM theory.

articleTitle: Mobile Health Application Design: A User-Centered Approach for Pulmonary Tuberculosis Screening
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease that ranks 13th as the deadliest disease in the world. Without treatment, pulmonary TB has a 50% chance of causing death. The presence of Covid-19 has further hindered the management of pulmonary TB, coupled with low awareness among the Indonesian population regarding early detection of TB, making it a serious problem. One of the ways to improve the early detection rate of TB is by developing a mobile health (mHealth) application. However, many mHealth applications fail because they are not designed to meet user needs. A design plan was created for a mobile screening application for pulmonary TB, aiming to increase awareness and interest in the early detection of TB using the User Centered Design method to ensure that the designed application fulfills user needs. The design of the mobile application is expected to facilitate the screening process from anywhere. By making screening easier, it is hoped to increase the interest in early detection of TB among the population. The usability test of the application design, conducted using the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) method, obtained excellent results in all six tested aspects. This indicates that the prototype design of the E-Screening TB application has met user criteria. The results of the six tested aspects, namely Attractiveness, Efficiency, Perspicuity, Dependability, Novelty, and Stimulation, all achieved an excellent level, which represents the highest ranking (top 10% of the dataset) in the UEQ testing method.

articleTitle: The Effect of Perceived Costs on Blockchain Adoption Intention: an Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Blockchain technology will soon change the way reliable transactions work. By combining distributed cryptographic methods, immutable ledgers, Transactions, and financial audit trails that will be recorded in consensus validation, communication can now use blockchain technology for business advantage. A blockchain-based business version is currently under consideration because they promise to guarantee trust, identity management, reputation management, processing time, reduced fees, and fraud in commercial transactions. However, the current problem is that there needs to be more research into how ready businesses are to use blockchain and at what cost. This study examines the mediating and moderating effects of perceived costs on the relationship between an organization’s readiness to adopt blockchain and its intention to accept it as something new. This study uses empirical and quantitative analysis methods in reviewing the document-based multiscale questionnaire that has been developed. In this study, we collected data from blockchain experts and used the Partial Least Square Structural Equation Model (PLS-SEM) analysis tool to test the assumptions of our framework. This study also uses Key Performance Map Analysis (IPMA) to explore the potential management impact of this issue, which is a novelty in previous studies. The results show that rather than mediating the relationship between Acceptance of Technology Readiness (TeRa) and intention to adopt blockchain, the perceived costs change. According to IPMA’s analysis, the most critical factor behind the desire to adopt blockchain is the perceived cost, with the highest support structure rating. This research is expected to assist decision-makers and stakeholders in developing and improving the latest performance and features needed for the successful implementation of this blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Relationship Quality Analysis Using Technology in the Business Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In the current era of Industry 5.0, the use of technology in the business sector, namely Digital Marketing, is put to good use by business actors. With social media as a medium of communication, business actors must establish good relationships with customers so that QU (Relationship Quality) is seen with BE (Customer Behavior), EX (Customer Experience) SMA (Social Media Marketing Activity). The basis for the urgency of this research is that many business actors do not know how important QU is, even though this can be used as a benchmark for business progress. The purpose of this research is to measure QU for BE, EX, and SMA using quantitative research methods by distributing online questionnaires to all social media users in Indonesia. A total of 49 questionnaires filled out by social media users were then analyzed and model-tested using PLS (Partial Least Squares). The results obtained are the findings of the H1 - H3 Hypothesis test which is declared ”Accepted” where SMA, EX, and BE affect QU positively. The novelty of this research is the results of measurement data on BE, EX, and SMA which can be used to improve quality and marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Loan Application Business Process Model with Multi-perspective Process Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The objective of this research is to improve the multi-perspective process mining model of the financial loan application process using ProM’s Multi-perspective Process Explorer plugin. The multi-perspective technique combines different process mining viewpoints, such as control-flow, resource, data, and time. The use of guards that contain guidelines or constraints that alter the process flow provides advantages in discovering interactions and relationships between different process components. Despite a 0.9% decrease in fitness, the outcomes of improving the Petri net model into a data Petri net show an improvement in precision of 8.6% and an increase in the F1-score of 4.4%. This study’s evaluation of guards’ ability to illustrate alternative perspectives inside the process shows that they can do so well, with an average F1-score of 84% across the four models examined.

articleTitle: Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network and Support Vector Machine Based on Model Optimization for Skin Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Skin cancer is common cancer in humans and can cause death. Handling early symptoms with the proper treatment can help patients to have a greater chance of life. The accuracy of early diagnosis in skin cancer patients plays an important role, so it needs a technique to classify skin cancer types accurately. Various deep-learning techniques for skin cancer diagnosis still require optimization to improve detection accuracy. This research proposes a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) technique using pre-trained Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) and Residual Network (ResNet-50) models and optimizing SVM parameters using grid search and a tree-based pipeline optimization tool (TPOT). The model was trained and tested using a dataset of 2000 dermoscopy images of skin cancer. This study used six experimental scenarios; each pre-trained model was trained and tested using a hybrid model with SVM. Three optimization scenarios were applied: grid search, default TPOT, and SVM-TPOT. The proposed model is proven to provide a more optimal accuracy of 91.5% on using the pre-trained model VGG-16 with the SVM-TPOT optimization method.

articleTitle: Improving Universal Rendering Performance on NuxtJS-based Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Universal rendering is a way to render a website by combining server and client-side rendering. Universal rendering promises to boost the performance and SEO score of the website. However, it can be computationally exhausting for the server. This prompts researchers to address this problem in multiple different environments. Two parameters that could be used to measure the aforementioned metrics are Time to First Byte (Or Latency) and Time to Interactive. This paper addressed the aforementioned problem of universal rendering in a NuxtJS-based web application. JMeter and Lighthouse was used to test each proposed solution’s performance and SEO score. Initially, there are three proposed solutions: lazy loading, SSR caching, and asset compression. This research proves that the aforementioned solutions effectively improve universal rendering performance in NuxtJS version 3.0.0. Each method has its pros and cons. For example, lazy loading and SSR caching are effective for improving the latency score, while asset compression is effective for enhancing the TTI score.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Indobert Optimization Hyperparameter Algorithm for Radicalism Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: The research aim to compare optimization algorithm of Indobert hyperparameter. Optimization Algorithm used Random Search, Bayesian Optimization, and Population Based Training (PBT). This study uses Indobert Base Phase 2 with a data set on Islamic radicalism, which consists of 1001 tweets in Indonesian that have been labeled positive, negative and neutral sentiments. Indicators that are compared from the three algorithms are accuracy, precision, recall and f1-score. The results showed that the best performance was achieved by PBT with an average accuracy score of 67%, 41% average precision, 81% average recall, and 40% F1 score. While the random search averaged 66% accuracy, 53% precision average, 75% recall average, and 53% F1-score. the results of Bayesian Optimization average 64% accuracy, 60% precision average, 60% average recall, and 60% F1-score

articleTitle: CCTV Camera With Intelligence Technology to Minimize Chicken Mortality Due to Hazardous Gas
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Utilization of CCTV cameras to identify upside down or downed chicken images equipped with Artificial Intelligence technology as an early effort to monitor the behavior of chickens due to toxic or dangerous gases in the broiler business is the application of technology used to reduce the problem of adult chicken mortality due to poisoning from accumulation. Ammonia gas produced from ready-to-harvest chicken manure is an air condition that is considered unsanitary. The purpose of the application of the use of PTZ type CCTV to reduce the number of deaths of chickens exposed to toxic gases is applied to farms with a cage area of $720 m^{2}$ consisting of 1 floor with a closed house (close house) and has a capacity of ± 11000 chickens. CCTV cameras will capture visual images of chickens in unnatural conditions where their movements are not as active as chickens in healthy conditions. The research method used is to design an Artificial intelligence-based system that is designed to consist of CCTV cameras with motion sensor technology, thermal imaging cameras to study the behavior of mature chickens ready to harvest that inhale harmful gases such as ammonia and methane from the feces in the husks, which then trapped and unable to turn around because of his body weight and position when he inhaled the gas. Another effort that has been made is to operate other devices in the form of a blower fan (Exhoustfan) which works automatically and the system is also equipped with manual operations contained in the panel box in the enclosure. Normal conditions are ready to harvest at the age of 28-30 days, the average body weight is achieved with a weight of 2000-2500 grams per head. The parameters set in this system, to ensure that the chickens remain healthy, are for the temperature value between $30^{\circ}{\mathrm{C}}$ to $33^{\circ}{\mathrm{C}}$ while the ammonia level is between 20 ppm to 40 ppm. The benefit of this research is that the results obtained from the application of CCTV with this AI method are framing images of chickens experiencing respiratory problems so that they are easily read by cage officers using a monitor screen. The test results show that the tool works well and can reduce the mortality rate of chickens to below 10%. So the conclusion is that CCTV equipment equipped with AI can function to provide images of objects that are considered potential problems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Human Resource Information System Implementation Success and Technology Trust Factors in the Context of a Manufacturing Company
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Human resource information system (HRIS) implementation does not always go as expected. Technical issues, such as connectivity problems and slow sofware performance, are often the main challenges. This highlights the need for a deeper understanding of the root causes that may arise in the use of these HRIS by manufacturing companies such as PT. Basirih Industrial. This study aims to evaluate the Talenta software based on the previous study framework. This framework include the implementation success of a software and technology trust. The results indicate that several constructs correlated significantly, such as situational normality and structural assurance both correlated with perceived Talenta benefit and user satisfaction, and user satisfaction correlated positively with perceived of Talenta software benefit.

articleTitle: Extraction Features Using Lexicon Embedding On Convolutional Neural Network For Fake Review Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Opinion review became important thing for both individuals and organizations. Although opinions were subjective, the collection of opinions had views, experiences, and interests that made opinions facilitate individuals in making buying decisions and organizations in improving their productions from existing feedback. However, many entities took advantage of doing deception by creating fake reviews. In this research, the authors created a fake review detection system using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method with feature extraction. The feature extractions included word embedding and lexicon embedding with naïve concatenation, multichannel, and separated convolution integration. The research aimed to obtain accuracy, precision, recall, and F1score from both features and with unbalanced and balanced classes. The authors used literature study to collect data and perform simulations. The authors’ models were experimented with both 6,632 hotel reviews and 60,763 restaurant reviews in the Yelp filtered datasets, with a ratio of 1 fake review to 6 genuine reviews in both topics. Our analysis of quantitative data revealed that the embedding lexicon feature had significant effect on base CNN model. The lexicon embedding separated convolution exhibited the best overall performance, achieving 78% accuracy, 81% recall, 74% precision, and 77% F1-score in balanced classes.

articleTitle: Examining the Determinants of Open Government Data Adoption: An Indonesian Case
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: In response to the growing interest in open government data (OGD) worldwide, there is a pressing need for research that explores the determinants of OGD adoption. This study aims to address this research gap by investigating the factors that influence the adoption of OGD among government agencies in the Indonesian context. Drawing on previous research on innovation adoption, the study develops a comprehensive research model that integrates the technology-organization-environment (TOE) framework and four key factors: perceived benefits, perceived risks, organizational readiness, and external pressures. To empirically examine the research model, survey data from 320 government agencies were collected and analyzed through regression and path analysis. The results of the study reveal a significant positive relationship between perceived benefits and external pressures toward the adoption of OGD by government agencies. This finding suggests that government agencies are more likely to adopt OGD when they perceive clear benefits and experience external pressures related to OGD adoption.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Phenomenon of Information and Communication Technology on Online Religious Engagement Among Indonesian Muslim Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Online religion is a phenomenon that utilizes the virtual world as a brand-new setting for fulfilling an individual’s spiritual needs, along with the rapid development of information, communication, and technology (ICT). It is a worldwide occurrence, especially among Muslim adolescents in Indonesia, which has the largest Muslim population and the most religious societies. This study investigated the variables affecting Indonesian Muslim adolescents’ online religious behavior. Using a quantitative approach and multiple regression analysis technique, this study found that online religious engagement among Indonesian Muslim adolescents is influenced by the level of religiosity and morality. The higher the level of religiosity and morality among Indonesian adolescents are, the higher they engage in online religious activities.

articleTitle: Analysis of Continuance Use Intention in BNI Mobile Banking Using The Expectation Confirmation Model (ECM)
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Banking companies follow developments in information technology, namely by developing mobile banking applications. Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) is the first state-owned bank to implement a mobile banking application. The 2021 Bank Service Excellence Monitor (BSEM) survey stated that BNI Mobile Banking was the application with the best performance in first place, but the results of the 2022 Populix survey placed BNI Mobile Banking in 4th place in mobile banking which is widely used in Indonesia, and the results of the survey by The Top Brand Award shows that there has been a decline in the ranking and percentage of BNI Mobile Banking since 2020-2022, which indicates that the intention to continue using it has decreased. This research aims to determine the level of Continuance Use Intention (CUI) in BNI Mobile Banking and find out what factors influence it. This research uses a quantitative approach and data processing using the PLS-SEM method with a sample size of 220 respondents, using the help of the SmartPLS application. This research uses the Expectation Confirmation Model (ECM) which has 4 variables, namely perceived usefulness, confirmation, satisfaction, and continuance use intention, as well as the addition of two variables, namely perceived security and self-efficacy to determine the intention to continue to use in terms of security and user confidence. The research results show that the level of Continuance Use Intention (CUI) in BNI Mobile Banking is 69%, categorized as a medium level of sustainability, and the factors that influence continuance use intention, namely confirmation, perceived usefulness, satisfaction, and perceived security. The self-efficacy variable has no effect on continuance use intention because the t-statistic value is below the threshold. It is hoped that the research results can provide recommendations to companies by considering the factors that influence the development of the BNI Mobile Banking application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Changes in Sentiment towards COVID-19 Vaccination in Indonesia Using the Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Vaccination against COVID-19 is one of the efforts to prevent transmission of COVID-19 in accordance with recommendations from the World Health Organization (WHO) and supported by the government through Presidential Decree 99 of 2020. Responding to the vaccination program, the public gave various opinions on Twitter. During the vaccination process, there are many changes in public opinions that can be analyzed over time. In this research, a time series analysis of sentiment changes was conducted using the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to find the best model. The data obtained will be weighted using the FastText method. Changes in sentiment will be divided into three phases, each being tested nine times with three variations of epochs, namely 10, 50, and 100. Each epoch has three variations of split data performed with percentage ratios of 80:20, 70:30, and 60:40. The study results show that the model can achieve the highest accuracy of up to 87.7%. Sentiment results in the first time series had positive sentiments of 1,454, while negative sentiments were 1,541, with an analysis confidence level of 83.1%. Sentiment results in the second time series had positive sentiments of 1,379, while negative sentiments were 1,265, with an analysis confidence level of 87.7%. Furthermore, the sentiment results in the third time series had 1059 positive sentiments, while 872 negative sentiments with an analysis confidence level of 85.43%. From the three-time series negative sentiment towards the COVID-19 vaccination policy is decreasing over time.

articleTitle: Development of PID Control System for a Smart Leg Splint using Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Rehabilitation is a comprehensive and interdisciplinary approach that aimed to restoring functionality and individuality who are undergoing recovery from physical and cognitive impairments, such as physical therapy, thermotherapy, cognitive therapy and assistive technology. Therefore, thermotherapy is an aspect of physical therapy that involves the application of heat to the human body for therapeutic purposes to pain relief, enhanced circulation, inflammation reduction and improved range of motion, which is significant for patients. This paper proposed the development of a smart leg splint implemented a closed-loop control system to regulate the temperature inside the splint. The experimental design and implementation of PID control system, emphasize on the importance of stability and accuracy in temperature control. The microcontroller and sensor technology were used to analyze and monitor the temperature while the system was operating. The results showed that a significant improvement in time taken to reach to the desired setpoint can be accomplished by modifying the parameters corresponding with the proportional, integral and derivative (PID) terms. The adjustment is essential for ensuring that the output remains stable at the desired temperature throughout the treatment duration. The temperature regulating responses can demonstrate variations due to the distinct positioning and design of a smart leg splint.

articleTitle: Online Compulsive Buying Behavior after Outbreak in Java – Big Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 11th International Conference on Cyber and IT Service Management (CITSM)
abstract: Shopping transactions underwent significant changes, particularly during the zenith of the spread of COVID19, when many businesses used digitalization to ensure their survival. Digitalization has also influenced changes in consumer behavior and continues to do so. This study assesses the level of online compulsive buying behavior that is impacted by website quality via online impulsive buying behavior and the use of e-payments following a change in consumer behavior that is the cause of the peak phase of COVID-19 dissemination. Purposive sampling was utilized in this study, with 393 respondents providing data. The Structural Equation Model (SEM) with WarpPLS 8.0 software was utilized as the analytical method. The study’s findings show that website quality, use of e-payments, and online impulsive buying behavior all have an impact on online compulsive buying behavior.
